description: A monochromatic 'Onyx' hue envelops the latest Yeezy Boost 350 V2, the lifestyle runner from adidas and Kanye West. The upper features a dark black Primeknit weave along with rope laces, while a post-dyed monofilament side stripe can be found in a lighter black shade. A full-length Boost unit is encapsulated in a semi-translucent ribbed TPU midsole, while a black rubber outsole rounds out the look.

The adidas Yeezy Boost 350 V2 is treated to a monochromatic makeover. 'Bone' features an ivory Primeknit upper and a matching traditional lace closure. An off-white webbing pull tab at the heel and a see-through monofilament side stripe continue the tonal theme. Branding arrives in the form of a Three-Stripes logo on the interior heel and a Yeezy word mark stamped on the sockliner. A full-length TPU-wrapped Boost midsole provides responsive cushioning.

The adidas Yeezy Slide “Onyx” is a monochromatic black colorway of the popular slip-on sandal by Kanye West. The “Onyx” was released in March 2022 and is a casual footwear style for the summer and beyond. Its lightweight, one-piece EVA foam body is designed in Onyx, or black, for a versatile look that goes with anything. Ridges on the outsole provide traction on slippery surfaces. Release date: March 7, 2022

This first colorway of Yeezy Wave Runner 700 from Kanye West was introduced in November 2017, following an initial public opening in the Yeezy Season 5 fashion show previously that year. The retro-inspired lines of the sneaker worked together with a chunky silhouette reminiscent of a previous age. A mesh base on the quarter panel is completed in gray and a yellow with a teal forefoot.

The Yeezy 700 V3 'Dark Glow' emerges with a look almost exactly like the 2020 'Alvah' colorway. However, the design is differentiated by the RPU cage, which sports a glow-in-the-dark finish in blue, rather than its predecessor's green. The rest of the upper is built with engineered mesh, while underfoot, a tonal EVA midsole inside a polyurethane core provides cushioning, giving way to a rubber outsole with a herringbone pattern for traction.

Utilizing a sleek monochrome finish, the adidas Yeezy Foam Runner ‘Onyx’ is an understated colorway for a futuristic slip-on. A molded one-piece upper showcases open vents for breathability, while the injected EVA foam is lightweight and is secured by a unique traction pattern for grip.

shoeName: adidas Yeezy Boost 350 V2 Carbon Beluga
description: The adidas Yeezy Boost 350 V2 ‘Carbon Beluga’ combines bold hues with a striking pattern. The dark grey upper in Primeknit, featuring black waves and orange speckles, is secured by rope laces. The lateral side showcases a bright orange stripe with the ‘SPLY-350’ branding. The sneaker offers a comfortable experience with its full-length Boost midsole and a supportive TPU cage. The design is finished with a robust rubber outsole.

Crafted from injected EVA foam, the seamless wide-strap upper of the adidas Yeezy Slide 'Slate Grey' arrives in medium grey and provides a lightweight/durable feel. The outsole is designed with deep grooves for optimal traction. adidas' signature three-stripe logo is debossed on the footbed, while a soft top layer ensures a cozy fit.

shoeName: adidas Yeezy Boost 350 V2 Steel Grey
description: Made from a stretchy Primeknit upper, the adidas Yeezy Boost 350 V2 'Steel Grey' sports distinct center stitching and a near see-through side stripe. The sock-like build also has a heel pull to make it easy to put on your shoes or take them off. A full-length Boost midsole is wrapped in a ribbed cage that keeps their monochromatic vibe.

The Yeezy Boost 350 V2 'Zebra' released on February 25, 2017, combining an upper white / core black Primeknit with a red SPLY 350 branding and a full-length translucent midsole boost. On November 16, 2018, a restock of the ' Zebra ' arrived, with more pairs hitting the marketplace and building on Kanye's commitment to make Yeezy more available to anyone who wished to acquire them.

shoeName: adidas Yeezy Boost 350 V2 Black Red
description: The Yeezy Boost 350 V2 'Bred' brings a classic colorway to its minimalist construction. The shoe's upper is built with Primeknit, finished in black and highlighted by the SPLY-350 branding on the side wall. More red marks the heel pull-loop, while rope laces secure the fit. Underfoot, a full-length Boost midsole wrapped in a black rubber cage provides cushioning. A rubber outsole with cutouts provides traction.

The Yeezy 350 V2 ‘Cream White’ combines a crisp Primeknit upper with tonal cream SPLY 350 branding and a translucent white midsole housing full-length Boost. First released in 2017, another 2018 drop helped fulfill Kanye West's oft-repeated 'Yeezys for everyone' mantra, as adidas organized the biggest drop in Yeezy history by promising pre-sale to anyone who signed up on the website.

The adidas Yeezy Slide 'Slate Marine' is crafted from a single piece of injected EVA foam in a calm shade of blue, featuring a wide strap on the upper that covers the foot. adidas' three stripes logo is subtly debossed on the footbed’s soft top layer, while the outsole is equipped with horizontal grooves for comfort and grip.

The adidas Yeezy Slide 'Dark Onyx' rolls out a minimalist charcoal upper, limiting the branding to a three-stripe logo debossed on the footbed. The midsole has injected foam for a plush feel, while the outsole has aggressive, serrated grooves for solid traction underfoot.

shoeName: adidas Yeezy Foam RNR MX Cinder
description: Bringing a refreshing touch to the slip-on design, the adidas Yeezy Foam Runner 'MX Cinder' incorporates vibrant accents. Crafted from injected EVA foam, the one-piece upper showcases an earthy blend of brown and tan tones. On the vamp, a striking black hue contrasts with unexpected pops of aqua blue. The contoured outsole, featuring a wavy tread pattern, provides excellent traction for every stride. Vents are strategically placed to improve breathability, while the plush top layer of the footbed ensures comfortable strides.

shoeName: adidas Yeezy Boost 350 V2 MX Dark Salt
description: The adidas Yeezy Boost 350 V2 'MX Dark Salt' arrives with a Primeknit upper featuring neutral shades of silver, grey, and black and laced up for a secure fit. The shoe features a full-length Boost midsole encased in a ribbed TPU cage which is supported by a grippy rubber outsole. A bold black side stripe complements the swirling design, running along the lateral side and matching the heel’s webbing pull tab.

shoeName: adidas Yeezy Foam RNR MX Granite
description: The adidas Yeezy Foam Runner 'MX Granite' is constructed from a single piece of resilient EVA foam and exhibits a marbled pattern with various shades of grey. The slip-on's sleek appearance is enhanced by sculpted lines, while airflow is promoted by mapped vents on the sides and vamp. The shoe’s contoured heel and textured footbed ride on an outsole which showcases a wavy traction pattern.

First released in 2019, the 2022 release of the Yeezy Slide 'Bone' brings back a neutral colorway of the minimalist sandal. A light ivory color permeates the one-piece slide, manufactured from injection-molded EVA for lightweight durability. The outsole features a set of grooves for traction, while a small adidas logo can be found on the footbed.

Released on February 15, 2016, the 2016 Yeezy Boost 350 ' Pirate Black ' is identical to the 2015 launch of Yeezy Boost 350 ' Pirate Black ' except for its upgraded heel inside padding and softer suede on its branded medial patches. The design combines a black / dark gray Primeknit upper with patterned dark gray rope laces, red heel tabs accents, and a black outsole.

The Yeezy Desert Boot 'Salt' dropped in September 2019 alongside accompanying colorways in ‘Rock’ and ‘Oil.’ This pair features a monochromatic pale grey finish, executed on an upper that combines breathable mesh with nubuck and suede overlays. A reflective pull tab runs down the length of the padded mesh tongue. Underfoot, a lugged rubber outsole is good for durable traction.

shoeName: adidas Yeezy Boost 350 V2 Core Black White
description: Featuring a black upper with a white band, SPLY 350 branding, and a translucent black midsole; the Yeezy Boost 350 V2 ‘Oreo’ released on December 17, 2016.

shoeName: adidas Yeezy Boost 350 V2 Beluga Reflective
description: The adidas Yeezy Boost 350 V2 'Beluga Reflective' revisits a 2016 colorway, pairing a predominantly grey Primeknit upper with an orange side stripe that features SPLY-350 branding. The knit build is interwoven with reflective fibers that provide enhanced visibility in low-light conditions. A full-length Boost midsole housed in a semi-translucent rubber cage provides support, durability and traction.

The Yeezy Desert Boot 'Rock' borrows elements from the Yeezy 500. The three-quarter boot is finished in a monochromatic Rock, with a mesh base overlaid by suede on the toe, eyestay and heel. An exaggerated mudguard and rope laces support the fit, while underfoot, a thick foam midsole provides cushioning. A rugged outsole is included for traction, with an embossed adidas logo on the bottom for the only branding hit.

The Yeezy Boost 700 arrives in an unmissable colorway, showcasing a vibrant Hi-Res Red on the mesh and leather upper portion of the lifestyle runner. Black suede overlays that run across the shoe are reminiscent of the original release, including the green pop on the front of the midsole and the grey toe cap. Full-length Boost cushioning is embedded in the sculpted midsole, highlighted with red and orange accents. A rubber Hi-Res Red herringbone outsole completes the look.

The adidas Yeezy Boost 350 V2 'Slate' features a two-tone color block, featuring a light tan hue across the Primeknit upper, intersected by a black stripe across the middle with 'SPLY-350' branding. Full-length Boost cushioning is embedded in the beige TPU translucent midsole, while a gum rubber outsole features a unique traction pattern for grip.

The Adidas Yeezy Boost 700 MNVN 'Geode' receives a pastel revamp. The upper features a delicate lavender shade in polyester textile held in place with bungee laces that don't require tying. The side panel displays a bold, metallic silver ‘700.’ The rubber outsole, with its herringbone-patterned tread, provides excellent traction. The shoe offers a lightweight feel with a full-length Boost midsole and a durable polyurethane carrier.

The adidas Yeezy Foam Runner 'Carbon' is an ultramodern slip-on crafted from injected EVA foam, showcased in a dark-grey hue with smooth, flowing lines and a supportive contoured heel. To ensure breathability, the shoe features strategically placed vents on the vamp and side panels. The textured footbed enhances the overall fit, while a robust rubber outsole ensures grippy traction.

An eye-catching shade of blue imbues the adidas Yeezy Slide ‘Azure.’ The modern build in one piece of injected EVA foam is constructed on a jagged outsole that provides support and grippyness. Subtle adidas branding is revealed on the footbed's top layer and on the heel.

shoeName: adidas Yeezy Boost 350 V2 Dazzling Blue
description: Delivering a two-tone colorway of Kanye West's popular lifestyle runner is the adidas Yeeezy Boost 350 V2 'Dazzling Blue.' The minimalist upper is constructed with flexible Primeknit, pitched to a solid black hue with contrasting threads woven throughout. A royal blue streak cuts through the lateral side, complete with signature SPLY-350 branding. Responsive cushioning arrives via a full-length Boost midsole wrapped in a semi-translucent TPU cage.

shoeName: adidas Yeezy Boost 350 V2 MX Rock
description: The Yeezy Boost 350 V2 'MX Rock' recalls a similar pattern found on the Yeezy Foam Runner 'MXT Moon Grey.' The silhouette features a one-piece Primeknit upper carrying a marbled blend of brown, black and grey. A solid black stripe adorns the lateral side, with additional black hits on the laces, liner and heel tab. A full-length Boost midsole wrapped in a black rubber cage arrives underfoot.

shoeName: adidas Yeezy Boost 350 V2 Core Black Red
description: Releasing alongside two other colorways, the Yeezy Boost 350 V2 'Red' dropped in November 2016. The shoe's Primeknit upper appears primarily in black, with red speckling throughout. A prominent red stripe runs from the heel to the toe, with SPLY-350 branding in further black. Underfoot, a black rubber cage overlays a full-length Boost midsole, giving way to a rubber outsole that sports cutouts to reveal the cushioning.

The adidas Yeezy 950 Boot 'Pirate' blends elements from a duck boot and a military boot in a mix of black rubber and ballistic nylon mesh. The leather and canvas lining enhances the boot's overall support, while the boot's sturdy midsole with its interior foam wedge rides on a lugged rubber outsole for optimal traction. Subtle branding is found on the alternating tongue tags, featuring debossed adidas and Yeezy logos.

The adidas Yeezy 700 V3 'Copper Fade' brings a gradient of burnt orange to an upper made of monofilament engineered mesh. No-tie elastic laces and an interior bootie construction deliver a secure fit. A translucent RPU cage provides added structure and durability. The low-top is mounted on a PU-encapsulated EVA midsole, with a grippy herringbone-traction rubber outsole underfoot.

The 'Flax' colorway of the Yeezy Slide sees the one-piece sandal arrive in a monochromatic dark beige hue. The entire shoe is made with injected EVA, making it lightweight, durable and comfortable. The outsole features a series of horizontal grooves, placed for optimal impact protection and traction.

The Yeezy Desert Boot 'Oil' adds a boot construction to Kanye West's signature line. Borrowing the suede toe box and oval overlays from the Yeezy 500, the shoe's three-quarter cut upper is built with a mix of smooth suede and mesh, finished tonally in Oil. Thick rope laces support the fit, as does the exaggerated mudguard. Underfoot, a bulky foam midsole provides cushioning, giving way to a rugged outsole for traction.

The Primeknit upper with 'SPLY-350' branding against a black stripe differentiates the adidas Yeezy Boost 350 V2 ‘Granite.' The neutral beige-grey of this lifestyle sneaker is constructed on a Boost midsole which can be seen via gaps in the rubber outsole. Clear TPU covers the sidewalls to enhance resilience and comfortable wear no matter the activity.

In July 2018, Kanye West and adidas released the Yeezy 500 ' Utility Black. ' The retro-inspired silhouette counterbalances a sleek, all-black design with its bulky form. What distinguishes this colorway from the standard triple-black finish is a unique use of tone – it's a semi-faded black that coats the combination of mesh and upper suede, as opposed to the pitch-black variety more common in the firmament of the sneaker.

The adidas Yeezy 500 'Stone Salt' brings an airy grey mesh upper with contrast overlays made with a mix of sultry leather and cow suede. Reflective piping accents aid visibility in low-light conditions, while a padded collar and Ortholite insoles combine for a plush all-around feel. An abrasion-resistant rubber wrap pairs with an adiPRENE+ midsole that has pods on the outsole modeled after Feet You Wear technology.

The Yeezy Boost 350 V2 ‘Static Non-Reflective’ 2018 is made to stand out, thanks to the contribution of exclusive features. The shoe boasts a translucent side stripe and 3M reflective accenting on the shoe’s rope laces, Primeknit upper, and Three-Stripes branding on the interior heel. The midsole is equipped with ridged TPU sidewalls with semi-translucent properties, displaying full-length adidas Boost cushioning inside.

The adidas Yeezy Slide 'Salt' showcases an allover grey color scheme and a featherweight design constructed from injected EVA foam. Its open-toe design enhances ventilation, and deep horizontal grooves on the outsole features deliver a grippy textured traction pattern. Branding on the outside is minimal, with the adidas three-stripe logo imprinted on the insole, which also includes a plush top layer for enhanced comfort with each step.

The Adidas Yeezy 450 'Utility Black' balances its bold design with a sleek, all-black color scheme. The shoe features a lightweight construction with an upper in black knit, fastened with laces and delivering a snug, sock-like cuff. The midsole, made of a black PU material, encases the sides and heel and offers both support and a unique look. The bottom of the shoe provides a contoured outsole with grooves for improved traction.

The Yeezy Boost 350 V2 'Zyon' emerges with a stylized look on a neutral colorway. Built with Primeknit, the upper is bisected by a darker monofilament stripe, while the collar sports solid grey to add to the aesthetic. Underfoot, a semitranslucent rubber midsole overlays a full-length Boost midsole, giving way to a gum rubber outsole for traction.

The Yeezy Boost 350 ‘Turtle Dove’ was the second shoe released in the adidas Yeezy collection after the Yeezy Boost 750 ‘OG.’ First seen on Kanye and his models at the Yeezy Season 1 fashion show in February 2015, this colorway was anointed 2015’s Shoe of the Year at the Footwear News 29th Annual Achievement Awards. The Yeezy 350 'Turtle Dove' will restock in April 2022.

The Yeezy Boost 380 'Onyx Non-Reflective' emerges with a neutral look on its lifestyle construction. Built with Primeknit, the upper appears in black and blue, with a translucent monofilament window cutting through the side wall. The shoe's sock-like upper is cushioned underfoot by a Boost midsole housed in a semitranslucent rubber cage, with a herringbone outsole providing traction.

In a bold departure from his previous old-school design, Kanye West expands into future-forward style with the adidas Yeezy Boost 700 V3. Debuted in December 2019, this Azael rendition features a black neoprene bootie with a notched collar and striped textile layer houses in a molded, open-work cage. Dynamic lacing offers secure lockdown. All of this is supported by Boost cushioning and a robust rubber outsole.

shoeName: adidas Yeezy Foam RNR Stone Salt
description: The adidas Yeezy Foam Runner 'Stone Salt' presents a sophisticated tan colorway. The outsole is equipped with a wavy traction pattern, providing reliable grip and stability on various surfaces. The shoe's distinctive one-piece design is constructed with injected EVA foam, ensuring a lightweight and long-lasting structure that effortlessly conforms to your feet. Breathability is ensured by strategically placed vents of different sizes which add a stand-out look as well as a cool fit.

The Yeezy Boost 700 V2 ‘Static’ is a reboot of the original Wave Runner. The upper boasts a slightly retooled design, while the midsole stays true to the original. This new version features a subdued colorway made up of soft, neutral shades. The layered build of the upper, featuring a mesh base with welded reflective overlays and leather paneling, is completed in tonal shades of grey and white. The design's chunky midsole, finished in matching white, is supported underneath by a black rubber outsole.

The Yeezy Boost 700 'Utility Black' 2019 brings an elevated two-tone look to its signature construction. The shoe's upper is built with a mesh base, overlaid by suede and smooth leather for support. Finished in black, the bulky midsole continues the look while housing a Boost unit for cushioning. The outsole sports a gum rubber construction for traction and a luxe finish.

The Yeezy Boost 350 V2 'Black Non-Reflective' emerges with an almost-monochromatic look on its signature construction. The shoe's upper is built with Primeknit, finished in black and complemented by a tonal monofilament stripe through the design. A touch of red brings color to the heel loop, while underfoot, a Boost midsole provides cushioning. The TPU shell that overlays the midsole continues down onto the rubber outsole for traction.

The adidas Yeezy Slide 'Granite' is crafted from a single piece of lightweight and resilient EVA foam in a dark grey hue. It combines a broad strap upper with a soft footbed on which adidas' signature three-stripe logo is showcased. To ensure grip and smooth strides, the outsole is designed with strategic groove placement.

shoeName: adidas Yeezy 500 High Tactical Boot Sand
description: The adidas Yeezy 500 Tactical Boot 'Sand' sports a tan ballistic nylon upper complemented with knit, suede and leather. A rubberized mudguard gives way to the Adiprene midsole. Taken from the Yeezy 500, the podular tooling makes these kicks stand out from the get-go.

shoeName: adidas Yeezy Boost 350 V2 Blue Tint
description: The Yeezy Boost 350 V2 'Blue Tint' features a white and grey upper with a red ‘SPLY-350’ txt on the side. It also arrives with blue laces, inner lining, and heel tab. This Yeezy dropped in December 2017 shortly after the Yeezy Boost 350 V2 Beluga 2.0.'

The Yeezy Boost 350 V2 'Carbon' brings a neutral look to its classic construction. The shoe's upper is built with Primeknit, finished in a mix of black and grey woven into the design. A post-dyed monofilament stripe cuts through the side wall, while no-tie bungee laces support the fit. Underfoot, a rubber cage overlays the full-length Boost midsole, which provides cushioning.

The Yeezy Slide 'Pure' 2021 from adidas Yeezy is a re-release of the same colorway that originally released in 2020. It's built from injected EVA foam with a monochromatic Ecru finish. The classic adidas' Three Stripes logo goes over the soft top footbed. The slides feature an extended sawtooth outsole and specifically placed grooves for better traction and comfort.

The adidas Yeezy Boost 700 'Hi-Res Blue' features a vibrant shade across most of the lifestyle runner designed by Kanye West. Hi-Res Blue appears on parts of the upper and midsole, contrasted by black suede overlays and grey near the front of the shoe and toe cap. The sculpted midsole features a hit of red near the front, while full-length Boost cushioning is embedded right above the gum rubber outsole.

Introducing a sleek and understated color scheme, the adidas Yeezy 450 'Stone Teal' showcases a lifestyle silhouette with a minimalist touch. The one-piece knit upper is adorned in a neutral grey tone and fastened securely with traditional laces with a stretchy sock-like collar for a comfortable fit. Breaking the monotony of the monochrome palette is a subtle hint of teal on the back heel. The lightweight construction is supported by a PU-injected midsole, characterized by distinct lines that contribute to the sneaker's unparalleled aesthetic.

The Yeezy Boost 700 'Salt' puts a neutral colorway on the lifestyle silhouette. The shoe's upper is built with a mesh base, overlaid by suede and leather, all finished in a greyscale design. Underfoot, the sculpted midsole houses a Boost unit for cushioning, giving way to a black rubber outsole for traction underfoot.

The Yeezy Boost 700 V2 'Vanta' emerges with a blacked-out look with this June 2019 release. The shoe's upper is built with multilayer mesh, overlaid by suede, all finished tonally. The sleek upper is supported underfoot by a bulky midsole that houses a full-length Boost unit for cushioning, giving way to a rubber outsole that provides traction.

With a design ahead of its time, the adidas Yeezy Foam Runner Kids ‘Onyx’ gives the low-key clog a noir treatment. With only subtle branding limited to an adidas logo on the outsole, the flair comes from the all-black molded upper in injected EVA foam featuring eye-catching vent throughout the vamp and a wavy pattern at the sole that offers multi-surface traction. A soft and textured top layer gives the footbed step-in comfort.

The 'Sand' colorway of the Yeezy Foam Runner applies a light tan hue across the molded one-piece upper. Crafted with EVA foam, a series of sculpted lines and ventilation holes pair with a textured footbed for all-day comfort. A unique contoured outsole utilizes a traction pattern for grip, with a small adidas logo stamped under the heel.

The adidas Yeezy Boost 350 V2 ‘Salt’, also referred to as ‘Jade Ash’, features a light green palette on the woven Primeknit upper, intersected with a black contrasting streak on the lateral side with SPLY-350 branding. Full-length Boost cushioning sits inside a TPU cage, with a rubber outsole tinted in a similar Jade color as the rest of the shoe.

The Yeezy Boost 350 V2 ‘Sesame’ features a subdued color palette that matches the shoe’s minimalist construction. The ventilated Primeknit upper retains the heel tab and distinct center stitch detailing but does away with the mirrored ‘SPLY-350’ branding. A semi-translucent rubber midsole underneath encompasses a full-length Boost cushioning, while a gum rubber outsole delivers enhanced traction.

The Yeezy Boost 700 'Analog' released in April 2019, more than two years after the debut of the silhouette. The shoe emerges with a neutral colorway that works various shades of off-white into its construction. Built with a mix of leather, mesh and suede, reflective detailing emerges near the heel. Underfoot, the signature bulky midsole houses a full-length Boost cushioning unit, giving way to a black rubber outsole for traction and contrast.

The Yeezy Boost 700 V2 'Tephra' brings a subdued colorway to the second iteration of the Yeezy 700 line. The shoe's upper is built with a layered mix of mesh and suede, finished in neutral hues. A darker look emerges on the signature bulky sole unit, which houses a full-length Boost midsole for cushioning. Underfoot, a gum rubber outsole provides traction while offering an elevated finish.

Giving a spirited makeover to the retro-inspired silhouette is the adidas Yeezy Boost 700 'Faded Azure.' A vibrant turquoise hue covers most of the upper with a layered assemblage crafted from mesh, suede, and leather. The monochromatic design is broken up by blue and tan mesh inserts atop the box, while reflective details add a hi-vis element to the layered build. There's responsive cushioning in a Boost midsole, housed within a sculpted PU carrier and made visible through cut-outs in the herringbone-traction rubber outsole.

shoeName: adidas Yeezy Boost 350 V2 MX Oat
description: The Yeezy Boost 350 V2 'MX Oat' features a one-piece Primeknit upper executed in a swirling pattern of orange, blue and yellow. A translucent stripe appears on the lateral side with a tonal pull tab on the heel. Underfoot, translucent rubber cage houses a full-length Boost unit, while a rubber outsole with cutouts provides traction.

shoeName: adidas Yeezy Boost 350 V2 Semi Frozen Yellow
description: Kanye West's Yeezy Boost 350 V2 in Semi Frozen Yellow first hit shops in November 2017, with a restock dropping in December 14, 2018. Dressed in Primeknit, the lifestyle runner is completed in an energetic bright yellow hue, one that extends to the laces, heel tab, and boost-infused ribbed rubber midsole.

shoeName: adidas Yeezy 350 V2 CMPCT Slate Panda
description: The adidas Yeezy Boost 350 V2 CMPCT 'Panda' appears in a stylish blend of neutral tones. The sneaker features a lightweight construction, supported by a springy Boost midsole. To enhance durability and provide added support, the midsole is encased in a semi-translucent TPU cage. The upper, crafted with 3D knitting technology, showcases a combination of white and grey hues, while elastic no-tie laces ensure effortless wearing and removal. A stretchy black collar on the ankle offers a secure and snug fit.

The somber color scheme of the Yeezy Boost 700 ‘Mauve’ blends black and purplish grey across its signature multi-layered upper. The complex arrangement showcases different varieties of mesh complemented with suede and textured leather paneling, all rising above a tonal sculpted midsole brightened with pops of neon green. Exterior branding is limited to understated Three-Stripes on the quarter panel and an adidas logo embossed on the outsole.

shoeName: adidas Yeezy Boost 350 V2 Mono Ice
description: The Yeezy Boost 350 V2 'Mono Ice' released as part of the four-shoe Mono Pack. Like the other models in the collection, the shoe updates its construction via monofilament mesh, replacing the traditional Primeknit. Finished in light blue throughout, a subtle side stripe cuts through the side wall, while a visible internal cage bolsters the fit. A webbing heel pull-loop is included for easy on and off, and underfoot, the signature rubber cage overlays the full-length Boost midsole. The shoe was an exclusive release in North America, Latin America and China.

The Yeezy Boost 350 V2 'Cinder' features a neutral look on its signature construction. Built with Primeknit, the Cinder upper includes a tonal monofilament stripe on the lateral side. A heel pull-loop provides easy on and off, while a similar finish marks the cage around the Boost midsole. A gum rubber outsole provides traction.

Kanye West's basketball-inspired mid-top silhouette emerges with a vibrant look on the Yeezy Quantum 'Frozen Blue.' Built with jacquard knit, the shoe's upper is overlaid by an RPU cage that highlights the design, while black neoprene marks the collar and tongue. Synthetic suede appears at the toe cap, and a seamless heel counter is included for stability. Underfoot, a semitranslucent TPU cage overlays the full-length Boost midsole, which offers cushioning.

The adidas Yeezy 500 'Stone Taupe' fortifies a tan open-cell mesh upper with suede and leather overlays. Reflective piping around the mudguard accents the look, while plush Ortholite insoles showcase the adidas logo. These shoes ride on a sculpted, podular adiPRENE+ midsole, inspired by the Feet You Wear cushioning system from the adidas KB8 3.

shoeName: adidas Yeezy Boost 350 V2 Mono Clay
description: Featuring a one-note finish emblematic of the larger collection, the Yeezy Boost 350 V2 'Mono Clay' released as part of the Mono Pack. Bringing an updated construction to the signature design. Built with monofilament mesh in place of the usual Primeknit, the shoe's upper appears entirely in orange, with slight variation provided by the side stripe. An internal cage is included for support, and a heel pull-loop offers easy on and off. Underfoot, full-length Boost, wrapped in a rubber cage, offers cushioning, while the shoe itself released exclusively in Asia Pacific and China.

shoeName: adidas Yeezy Foam RNR Clay Red
description: The adidas Yeezy Foam Runner ‘Clay Red’ showcases a sleek and monochrome dark beige color. The shoe's design features a single-piece construction made from lightweight and durable injected EVA foam. Breathability is enhanced with strategically placed vents throughout the upper. The molded collar and textured footbed provide a snug and comfortable fit. The wavy traction pattern on the outsole offers grip on various surfaces.

Featuring a rubberized foam build with a lightly textured finish is the adidas Yeezy Slide 'Ochre.' Its aged aesthetic comes from a diffuse brown palette marked with subtly discolored patches. Branding is limited to an adidas three-stripe logo on the soft top layer of the footbed. The slip-on is built on an outsole with deep horizontal grooves to improve cushioning and traction.

shoeName: adidas Yeezy Boost 350 V2 Sand Taupe
description: The Yeezy Boost 350 V2 'Sand Taupe' emerges with a neutral look. Built with Primeknit, the shoe's upper appears in brown and light orange, with a bound collar and no-tie laces supporting the fit. The side wall includes the signature post-dyed monofilament stripe, while underfoot, a semitranslucent rubber cage houses a full-length Boost midsole, which offers cushioning.

shoeName: adidas Yeezy 350 V2 CMPCT Slate Onyx
description: The adidas Yeezy Boost 350 V2 CMPCT 'Slate Onyx' is a versatile and understated colorway showcasing a seamless blend of black and grey threads. Its stretchy sock-like collar and no-tie elastic laces offer easy on and off functionality while innovative 3D knit construction provides a snug and lightweight fit. The full-length Boost midsole is encased in a semi-clear TPU cage, and rides on a sturdy rubber outsole.

The adidas Yeezy Boost 350 V2 Kids 'Bone' has an off-white Primeknit upper highlighted by distinctive center stitching and a post-dyed monofilament side stripe. No-tie elastic laces and a pull tab at the heel make on and off a breeze. The Yeezy logo adorns the insoles for a signature look. A full-length Boost midsole is engulfed in a plastic cage, all anchored by a rubber outsole.

shoeName: adidas Yeezy Boost 350 V2 Mono Mist
description: Part of the four-shoe Mono Pack, the Yeezy Boost 350 V2 'Mono Mist' brings an updated construction to the signature Yeezy silhouette. Rather than Primeknit, the shoe's upper is built with monofilament mesh, with the neutral finish complemented by a subdued side stripe through the side wall. A visible internal cage supports the fit, while a webbing heel pull-loop is included for easy on and off. Underfoot, a translucent rubber cage overlays the full-length Boost midsole, which offers cushioning. The shoe's release was exclusive to Europe, Africa, India, the Middle East, Russia, Ukraine and China.

Dropping with a reflective colorway, the Yeezy Boost 350 V2 'Yecheil Non-Reflective' emerges with a vibrant look. The upper is built with Primeknit, working a series of bright hues into its construction. Contrasted by a black monofilament stripe that runs through the design, a black TPU midsole underfoot houses a Boost unit, with a rubber outsole for traction.

shoeName: adidas Yeezy Slide Glow Green (2022/2023 Restock)
description: A bright and vivid ‘Green Glow’ makes up the newest adidas Yeezy Slides, as an all-over neon green treatment is applied to a single piece of injected EVA foam. Showing no branding on the entire sandal save for a small adidas Three-Stripes logo on the footbed, the contoured shape of the slide is simple and clean with deep horizontal grooves for traction.

The Yeezy Boost 700 'Bright Blue' features a vibrant two-tone look between its upper and tooling. The shoe's upper, built with mesh and suede, appears primarily in blue, complemented by black suede. Reflective detailing on the side wall further highlights the design, while underfoot, the sculpted orange midsole houses Boost to provide cushioning, giving way to a black rubber outsole with a herringbone pattern for traction.

shoeName: adidas Yeezy 500 High Tactical Boot Utility Black
description: The adidas Yeezy 500 Tactical Boot 'Utility Black' showcases a black ballistic mesh upper with matching suede overlays, and is fastened with speed lacing for quick adjustments. The rubber mudguard seamlessly integrates with the podular adiPRENE+ midsole, which is borrowed from the original Yeezy 500 design. The boot’s extended padded collar reaches up to the calf for optimal fit.

The Yeezy Boost 700 'Wash Orange' references the color story of the Yeezy Boost 700 'Wave Runner,' maintaining a subdued palette with accents throughout. The mixed-material upper arrives in grey, black, teal and blue. Reflective Three Stripes branding appears beneath the mesh paneling. A bulky orange midsole lends the model its name. A black rubber outsole featuring cut-out detailing provides traction.

shoeName: adidas Yeezy Boost 350 V2 Ash Pearl
description: The Yeezy Boost 350 V2 'Ash Pearl' features a contrasting look on its signature design. The shoe's re-engineered Primeknit upper appears in a mix of indigo, grey and navy, contrasted by the off-white and beige on the upper half of the build. A post-dyed monofilament stripe cuts through the side wall, while underfoot, an off-white rubber cage overlays the full-length Boost midsole, which provides cushioning.

The Yeezy Boost 350 V2 'Light' features a clean colorway with unique detailing. While the shoe's upper, built with Primeknit, appears in white, but when exposed to sunlight, the knit construction appears in pink. The monofilament stripe also changes color, turning to amber, while underfoot, the usual tooling provides cushioning, consisting of a full-length Boost midsole wrapped in a rubber cage.

The Adidas Yeezy 700 V3 ‘Fade Salt’ features a predominantly neutral color scheme, with the upper made from a white, black and gray engineered mesh. The interior features a bootie construction for a secure and comfortable fit, and a RPU overlay with glow-in-the-dark qualities adds support. The full-length EVA midsole provides cushioning, is encased in a sturdy off-white polyurethane material and rides on a rubber outsole with a herringbone pattern for improved traction.

An earthy color tone is featured on the adidas Yeezy 500 'Brown Clay' throughout the branding-free upper with a ventilated open mesh base with soft suede overlays and a reinforced rubber mudguard. The subdued color palette extends to the sneaker's high-rebound adiPRENE+ midsole, modeled after the retro 'Feet You Wear' technology used on Kobe Bryant's adidas KB8 3 from 1999. It's built on rubber pods to deliver better grip.

The Yeezy 500 ‘Salt’ persists with the same monochromatic design used on the bulky lifestyle silhouette's previous colorways. Here, a light grey dresses the layered upper, built with a combination of cow suede, premium leather, mesh, and nubuck accents. A rubber wrap on top of the midsole offers enhanced stability while reflective trim around the eyelets provide visibility in low-light conditions.

Celebrity Kanye West retools the 500 profile with the adidas Yeezy 500 High. Debuted in December 2019, this revamp boasts a Slate-colored neoprene base layered with suede and tumbled leather elements. Utility laces secure the tongue and a patterned mudguard bolsters the sidewall. The molded midsole is supported by Adiprene cushioning while the robust rubber outsole utilizes a wavy tread pattern.

The Yeezy 500 first appeared as a pre-order in February 2018, before a wider release in April 2018. The 'Blush' colorway features a light taupe hue throughout the shoe, including the upper which is comprised of suede, mesh and leather. The sculpted midsole is lifted from the adidas KB8 III, which touted 'Feet You Wear' technology from the 1990s.

shoeName: adidas Yeezy Foam RNNR Stone Sage
description: The adidas Yeezy Foam Runner 'Stone Sage' showcases a slight marbleized print across a beige hue. As with all Foam Runners, a one-piece build is crafted with injected EVA foam, sculpted for comfort as there are several cored out holes for ventilation and breathability. A textured footbed offers a comfortable fit, while a wavy traction pattern offers grip.

shoeName: adidas Yeezy Knit RNR Fade Onyx
description: An innovative laceless design distinguishes the adidas Yeezy Knit Runner 'Fade Onyx,' whose knit upper arrives in an array of grey hues. A concealed EVA midsole is supported underfoot by a modified herringbone-patterned rubber outsole. The flexible collar displays the shoe size on its lateral side, and the interior is lined with gentle textile for a cozy fit.

Dressing the slip-on sandal in a one-note finish is the adidas Yeezy Slide Kids 'Onyx.' The build is made with injected EVA foam with open-toe construction that improves airflow. A soft top layer is marked with a debossed adidas logo, while a serrated outsole provides better traction.

shoeName: adidas Yeezy Foam RNR Desert Sand
description: Crafted from injected EVA foam that is molded and sculpted into one overall piece that forms the shoe, the Yeezy Foam Runner is a design and engineering marvel. A light Desert Sand hue envelopes the entire slip-on, including the herringbone traction pattern on the outsole and the smooth and detailed upper.

shoeName: adidas Yeezy Foam RNR MX Carbon
description: Continuing the MX colorways with a blend of swirling colors, this 'MX Carbon' iteration of the Yeezy Foam Runner sees the lifestyle silhouette splashed with a mix of black, yellow and pink. Crafted with a lightweight EVA foam, the one-piece molded upper features a sculpted look with holes for ventilation, with a contoured footbed for comfort. The colorful pattern extends to the outsole, where a wavy traction pattern offers grip for multiple surfaces.

Kanye West's debut basketball sneaker, the Yeezy Quantum 'Quantum' features a unique design achieved through wavy cutout strips. Those strips reveal a mesh base below the knit construction of the upper, while reflective accents emerge throughout. Off-white suede emerges at the toe, while underfoot, a Boost midsole and herringbone outsole provide cushioning and traction.

The Yeezy Boost 700 'Enflame Amber' features a contrasting look between its upper and tooling. The shoe's upper is built with mesh, overlaid by suede and finished in a mix of brown and beige. A tonal toe cap supports the fit, while a hit of blue marks the mesh toe box itself. Underfoot, drop-in Boost provides cushioning, overlaid by an orange EVA carrier, while the herringbone rubber outsole reveals the cushioning unit itself via cutout detailing.

shoeName: adidas YZY QNTM BSKTBL (Performance Basketball Model)
description: In his first attempt at creating a basketball shoe, Kanye West introduces the adidas Yeezy Basketball 'Quantum' which combines his unique design style with practical design. The shoe features a neoprene bootie with lace-up closure accented with snakeskin-like texture and a suede toe. The semi-clear casing holds responsive Boost cushioning and acts as the sole for improved traction.

The high visibility of the adidas Yeezy Boost 350 V2 'Yeezreel Non-Reflective' shares Kanye West's unique approach to style. Dropped in December 2019, the iteration is eye-catching in a colorful Primeknit bootie utilizing vivid rope laces, a translucent monofilament streak across the lateral, and a rear pull tab with unusual red stitching. A vivid Tubular rubber sole displays full-length Boost technology for energy return.

The futuristic adidas Yeezy Foam Runner 'Vermilion' slip-on features a one-note scarlet finish to the clog-like silhouette, tying back to the first time that Kanye West introduced the familiar monochrome palette to his partnership with adidas. It features a sustainable build, highlighted by a single piece of foam made in part with hydroponically produced algae. Ventilation ports throughout the vamp and side panels offer more airflow, with the heel designed to cradle the back of the foot for a non-slip fit.

The Yeezy Boost 350 V2 'Flax' emerges with a neutral colorway. Built with Primeknit, the upper appears in Flax, with a post-dyed monofilament stripe revealing interior elements of the shoe. Underfoot, the semitranslucent rubber cage overlays a Boost midsole, giving way to a gum rubber outsole for traction.

The Adidas Yeezy 450 'Cinder' is a sleek and modern shoe delivered in a dark taupe color scheme. The shoe features knit textile on the upper which forms to the foot like a sock and is secured by rope laces and an elastic ankle cuff. The Ortholite sockliner provides added comfort and the rubber outsole is designed with a wavy pattern for improved traction. The midsole, made of PU material, is cushioned and has unique tapered ‘fingers’ that run up the sides and back of the shoe.

Adding a bit of color to a mostly neutral colorway of Kanye West's basketball-inspired silhouette is the adidas Yeezy Quantum 'Amber Tint.' Gold, bronze, and brown tones are featured on the wavy synthetic overlays, which are on a semi-translucent mesh upper. The breathable built has a grey synthetic suede toe cap and a stretchy black neoprene collar and tongue with a molded heel counter that cradles the back of the foot. Responsive cushioning is throughout the full-length Boost midsole with a durable TPU cage and is supported by a herringbone-traction rubber outsole.

The Yeezy Slides 'Pure' brings a neutral look to its signature slide design. The shoe's one-piece construction is built with EVA, finished tonally throughout and sporting its lone branding via the Three-Stripes on the footbed. Underfoot, the outsole incorporates a series of deep flex grooves to offer flexible traction.

The Yeezy Boost 350 V2 'Israfil' emerges with a patchwork design on its Primeknit construction. Butil with a mix of tan and grey yarns, the upper is highlighted by the signature monofilament stripe through the construction. Underfoot, a full-length Boost midsole provides cushioning, wrapped in a semitranslucent rubber shell that leads into a gum rubber outsole underfoot.

shoeName: adidas Yeezy Foam RNR Stone Taupe
description: The adidas Yeezy Foam Runner 'Stone Taupe' showcases an easy-to-wear slip-on in a tan hue. Crafted from one piece of injected EVA foam, the shoe features a textured footbed for a secure fit and strategically placed vents for breathability. The outsole provides reliable grip on wet and dry surfaces with its wavy traction pattern.

Kanye West and adidas continued their collaboration with the Yeezy Boost 350 V2 ' Butter, ' which struck shops in June 2018. The minimalist silhouette features center stitching on the inverse Primeknit upper side, with the signature ' SPLY-350 ' inscription now printed on the inside side. The heel tab continues, completed in a bright yellow hue that suits the knitted upper, rope laces, and boost-infuse laces.

Releasing alongside kid and infant sizes, the first 350 to receive such a release, the Yeezy Boost 350 V2 'Clay' is the full-size iteration of the shoe. Featuring a Primeknit upper in Clay, a horizontal microfilament strip cuts through the design. An orange heel strap supports the fit, while underfoot, a full-length Boost unit is visible through the translucent midsole. A rubber outsole provides traction.

Distinguished by a fade gradient that moves from a mauve hue to a bright magenta at the heel, the adidas Yeezy 700 V3 ‘Fade Carbon’ is a lifestyle runner in an eyecatching colorway. A translucent RPU cage overlays the engineered mesh upper. An interior bootie offers a snug, comfortable fit while traction and grip are assured from the herringbone-patterned rubber outsole.

The adidas Yeezy Boost 700 MNVN in the ‘Metallic’ colorway features a neutral shade on its chunky running shoe. The grey polyester textile upper is reinforced with sturdy no-sew overlays and displays a bold ‘700’ in shimmering silver. The streamlined design sits on a sculpted PU midsole that houses Boost cushioning, which can be seen through the cut-outs in the rubber outsole with a herringbone pattern for grip. The bungee laces, which don't require tying, ensure a secure fit.

The futuristic build of the adidas Yeezy 450 'Resin' features a pale green monochrome finish throughout the one-piece knit upper and claw-like midsole with tapered 'fingers' that wrap up the side panels. The shoe's detailing includes tonal rope laces, a stretchy sock-like cuff, and an Ortholite insole marked with dual adidas and Yeezy branding. It's built on a contoured rubber outsole with a wavy traction pattern.

shoeName: adidas Yeezy Boost 350 V2 Tail Light
description: The Yeezy Boost 350 V2 'Tail Light' gets its name from the vibrant hit at the heel. The shoe's Primeknit upper features a largely neutral look, finished in grey and complemented by a monofilament stripe. However, the shoe's heel pull-loop adds color to the look in red. Underfoot, the semitranslucent rubber midsole includes a full-length Boost midsole for cushioning.

The Yeezy Boost 380 'Covellite' features a series of subdued tones throughout its signature construction. Built with re-engineered Primeknit, the shoe's upper appears in navy, indigo and grey, creating a camouflage-style pattern that's bisected by a tonal monofilament window. Perforations throughout provide breathability, while underfoot, a rubber cage overlays the Boost midsole, which provides cushioning. A herringbone rubber outsole offers traction.

shoeName: adidas Yeezy Boost 700 MNVN Bright Cyan
description: The Yeezy Boost 700 MNVM 'Bright Cyan' emerges with a vibrant look. Built with lightweight polyester, the shoe's upper appears in blue, bolstered by no-sew overlays and highlighted by reflective detailing. No-tie bungee laces secure the fit, while '700' branding marks the lateral side. Underfoot, a sculpted PU midsole provides cushioning, also housing Boost, with the rubber outsole sporting a herringbone pattern for traction.

The Adidas Yeezy 700 V3 ‘Clay Brown’ features an upper in monofilament engineered mesh that is primarily black with bold brown stripes along the side panels. These stripes are accentuated by the open design of the RPU cage, which adds structure and a modern look to the bootie-like design of the sneaker. The robust EVA midsole is protected by a tough PU wrap and supported by a rubber outsole with a herringbone tread for added traction.

Offering a futuristic aesthetic with a subdued, monochromatic finish is the adidas Yeezy Foam Runner 'Ochre.' A dark beige hue covers the one-piece foam build that has ventilation ports of varying shapes and dimensions that increase airflow while adding to the slip-on's flowing lines. 'FOAM RNNR' is seen on the interior collar with the shoe size and 'Made in USA' branding. The outsole features a wavy traction pattern for a better grip.

shoeName: adidas Yeezy Boost 350 V2 Static Black (Reflective)
description: The Yeezy Boost 350 V2 'Black Reflective' features a largely monochromatic look with a unique accent throughout. The shoe's Primeknit upper appears in black, with a tonal monofilament stripe throughout the design. Reflective elements are sewn into the construction, while the heel loop includes hits of red for the only color. Underfoot, a full-length Boost midsole provides cushioning, wrapped by a TPU shell that continues onto the outsole.

The Yeezy Slide 'Resin' 2022 relaunch revives one of the original hues of the cutting-edge comfy sandal. Constructed from a single piece of injected-molded EVA foam, the sandal boasts a light green hue with a subtle texture on the surface. The only branding present is a subtle adidas logo embossed on the cushioned footbed. The rugged outsole features deep horizontal grooves creating a sawtooth pattern which provides excellent shock absorption and traction.

The adidas Yeezy Quantum 'Mist Slate' features an upper that merges a robust cream-hued cage with see-through mesh, a matching synthetic suede layer on the forefoot, and a smooth heel counter. The laces, tongue, and inner lining provide contrast with bold hits of black. The full-length Boost midsole encased in translucent TPU rides atop a grippy herringbone-patterned rubber outsole.

The Yeezy 700 V3 'Kyanite' sports vibrant accents on its signature construction. Built with monofilament engineered mesh, the shoe's upper appears with a white base highlighted by flowing blue stripes, overlaid by an RPU cage that glows in the dark. An inner bootie construction supports the fit, with a rubber toe cap included for durability. Underfoot, a PU cage encapsulates the EVA midsole, which provides cushioning, giving way to a herringbone rubber outsole for traction.

shoeName: adidas Yeezy Foam RNR Clay Taupe
description: Combining a versatile and muted color palette with a lightweight construction ideal for summer, the adidas Yeezy Foam Runner 'Clay Taupe' offers effortless style and comfort. The upper in a subtle beige hue features sculpted lines and a contoured heel and is crafted from injected EVA foam. The footbed of the shoe is designed with a soft and textured top layer, delivering a comfortable and snug fit for extended wear. Strategically placed vents throughout the vamp and sides provide optimal ventilation, ensuring your feet stay cool.

shoeName: adidas Yeezy Boost 700 MNVN Blue Tint
description: The Yeezy Boost 700 MNVN 'Blue Tint' brings a pastel look to its signature construction. The shoe's upper is built with polyester, finished in Blue Tint and contrasted by black on the collar lining, tongue and no-sew overlays. No-tie bungee laces secure the fit, while the 700 branding on the side wall adds reflective detailing. Underfoot, the sculpted polyurethane midsole incorporates drop-in Boost for cushioning.

Designed with a monochromatic appeal, the adidas Yeezy Slide Kids 'Dark Onyx' have a foam-injected footbed for a cushioned feel. These flexible and lightweight slip-ons roll out a molded one-piece upper encased by a soft top layer above the footbed. The latter is adorned with a debossed three-stripe logo, while the outsole has strategically-placed grooves for accurate traction and a comfortable feel.

The Yeezy Boost 380 'Pepper' emerges with a neutral look on its progressive construction. Built with Primeknit, the upper appears in a mix of white and blue, with a tan monofilament window contrasting the side wall. Perforations on the quarter panel provide breathability, while underfoot, the midsole incorporates full-length Boost for cushioning. A raised heel is included for a more natural stride.

The Yeezy Boost 380 'Mist Non-Reflective' emerges with a camouflage-style pattern on its Primeknit upper, achieved through a varied application of its neutral colors. Perforations on the side wall, aligned with the monofilament stripe, provide breathability, while underfoot, the Boost midsole sports an elevated heel. The outsole incorporates gum rubber for traction.

The Yeezy 500 'Taupe Light' features a neutral look and a mixed-material construction. The shoe's upper features an open-mesh base, overlaid by cow suede and leather and finished entirely in Taupe Light. The eyelets include reflective piping to accent the look, while the midfoot sports a rubber wrap to bolster the design. Underfoot, an Adiprene+ midsole is included for cushioning, with a rubber outsole offering traction.

The Adidas Yeezy 500 ‘Granite is a lifestyle running shoe with a sleek and understated gray color scheme. The upper is crafted from charcoal mesh and features suede and leather accents in a matching hue, with a plush Lycra lining in the collar for comfort. A smooth rubber mudguard enhances durability, while the podular adiPRENE+ midsole, influenced by the 1999 Kobe Bryant signature model ‘KB8 3,’ provides cushioning. This minimalist design minimizes flashy branding for a sophisticated look.

The Yeezy Boost 700 V2 'Cream' brings a subdued look to its running-inspired construction. Built with a rolled knit design, the shoe's upper is bolstered by no-sew skins and nubuck overlays, finished in a mix of grey and tan. Underfoot, the subdued look continues on the off-white EVA midsole, which houses drop-in Boost for further cushioning. A herringbone rubber outsole offers traction.

Developed with the help of Steve Smith, the Yeezy 450 'Cloud White' is a deconstructed sneaker. The shoe's upper is built with one-piece textile knit, finished in grey and forgoing any branding. An elastic cuff works with the integrated lacing system to secure the fit, with 'fingers' climbing up from the molded outsole to further bolster the design. The sole unit itself appears in white, with the outsole offering traction underfoot.

shoeName: adidas Yeezy Boost 350 V2 Mono Cinder
description: The Yeezy Boost 350 V2 'Mono Cinder' features a blacked-out look on its updated construction. Releasing as part of the Mono Pack, the shoe's upper is built with monofilament mesh in place of the usual Primeknit, finished entirely in black. The signature side stripe adds a minor deviation, while an internal cage and webbing heel pull-loop support the fit. Underfoot, the tonal tooling includes a Boost midsole wrapped in a rubber cage for cushioning, while the shoe itself dropped exclusively on Yeezy Supply.

The adidas Yeezy Foam Runner 'Sulfur' slip-on features an all-over pale ochre finish, built from EVA foam and hydroponically produced algae. Ventilation ports providing breathability are visible on the vamp and side panels. A raised sculpted heel offers a supportive, comfortable fit. A wave-patterned outsole anchors the lightweight design and adds traction.

The adidas Yeezy 500 'Bone White' returns with an upper in a pristine ivory hue in a combination of breathable mesh, sturdy suede, and supple leather overlays. For enhanced support and durability, a seamless rubber mudguard is incorporated into the design. The adiPRENE+ midsole, inspired by the adidas KB8 3, offers lightweight cushioning with its podular construction. To improve visibility in the dark, the eyestay is adorned with reflective piping.

The adidas Yeezy 450 'Stone Grey' features a seamless one-piece knit upper in a medium grey hue, complemented by a comfortable sock-like collar and a traditional lace closure. A wavy traction pattern that guarantees superior grip arrives via the contoured rubber outsole. Standing out with its unique aesthetics, the PU-injected midsole wraps around the sides, ensuring reliable support.

The Yeezy Boost 350 V2 ' Beluga 2.0 ' released on November 25, 2017 with its name coming from the colorway on the first Yeezy Boost 350 V2. Instead of the vivid orange color found on the initial ' Beluga ' sneaker, the shoe displays a silent gray color on the side. The Yeezy Boost 350 V2 ' Beluga 2.0 ' also contains an orange stitching heel tab and a inverse logo of ' SPLY-350 ' on the laterals.

The Yeezy Boost 350 V2 'Natural' brings a neutral look to its lifestyle construction. The shoe's upper is built with Primeknit, finished in a subdued mix of hues and complemented by a post-dyed monofilament stripe on the side wall. No-tie bungee laces support the fit, while the inside of the heel includes Three-Stripes. Underfoot, a rubber cage overlays the full-length Boost midsole, which provides cushioning.

The Yeezy 700 V3 'Alvah' brings a blacked-out look to its sculpted construction. Buit with black and grey mesh, the upper is overlaid by a glow-in-the-dark RPU exoskeleton to support the fit. The base of the tongue sports reflective detailing, while underfoot, the shoe's EVA midsole is encapsulated by PU.

The Yeezy Boost 350 V2 'Citrin Non-Reflective' dropped in September 2019, featuring a two-tone Primeknit upper that utilizes different weaves for a multi-textured look. The sneaker’s lateral side is marked by a post-dyed monofilament side stripe, offering the design a see-through element. A similar dynamic is at work on the semi-translucent midsole, which reveals full-length Boost cushioning within.

shoeName: adidas Yeezy Boost 350 V2 Desert Sage
description: The Yeezy Boost 350 V2 'Desert Sage' sports a vibrant accent on its otherwise-neutral design. Built with Primeknit, the upper appears in Desert Sage, with reflective detailing on the signature monofilament stripe. The inner lining highlights the look in orange, while underfoot, a full-length Boost midsole is housed inside a rubber shell.

shoeName: adidas Yeezy Boost 700 MNVN Triple Black
description: The Yeezy Boost 700 MNVN 'Triple Black' released in February 2020 with a blacked out look on its signature construction. The shoe's upper emerges with a nylon construction supported by heat-welded panels, accented by 3M reflective branding on the lateral side. Forgoing the usual Three-Stripes, the shoe is supported underfoot by an enclosed Boost midsole and a herringbone traction pattern on the outsole.

The adidas Yeezy Quantum 'Onyx' mid-tops have basketball roots with black and charcoal color splashes throughout the mesh upper. With a supported synthetic suede toe cap and detailed embroidering, the ankle is supported by a neoprene collar and adds more visibility when in a dark setting by the reflective heel paneling. It's built on a full-length Boost midsole protected with a semi-translucent TPU cage with a herringbone-tread rubber outsole to get a better grip.

shoeName: adidas Yeezy Boost 700 MNVN Laceless Analog
description: The Adidas Yeezy Boost 700 MNVN Laceless ‘Analog’ features a simple and understated color scheme. The upper is made of ivory-colored polyester fabric and has black, seamless overlays and reflective silver lettering that spells out ‘700.’ It sits on a sculpted PU midsole that contains full-length Boost cushioning for a comfortable and springy feel. The outsole is made of herringbone rubber for improved traction with every stride.

A fully neutral look, the Yeezy Boost 350 V2 'Earth' features an Earth finish throughout its signature construction. The shoe's Primeknit upper includes a post-dyed monofilament stripe through the design, while a textile heel pull-loop provides easy on and off. Underfoot, the tonal look continues onto the tooling, which includes an encapsulated Boost midsole and gum rubber outsole.

shoeName: adidas Yeezy 350 V2 CMPCT Slate Bone
description: The Adidas Yeezy Boost 350 V2 CMPCT ‘Slate Bone’ features a subtle grey color scheme on the upper, made from a 3D knit textile that provides a snug fit. The shoe is designed with a responsive Boost midsole from adidas, surrounded by a semi-transparent TPU cage and visible through cutouts on the rubber sole. The slip-on design is easy to wear with elastic laces that don't need to be tied.

shoeName: adidas Yeezy Desert Boot Taupe Blue
description: The first model in the line to not feature a monochromatic look, the Yeezy Desert Boot 'Taupe Blue' sports a split, vibrant design. The shoe's Yeezy 500-inspired upper is built with a mix of mesh, leather and suede, finished in a subdued mix of hues. Supported by stacked eyelets and high-cut padded collar, the upper is highlighted by the bright blue around the base of the build. More blue marks the midsole and high-traction rubber outsole.

The unique construction of the Yeezy 450 features a blacked-out look on the Yeezy 450 'Dark Slate.' Also lacking exterior branding, the shoe's knit upper appears in black, with an integrated lacing system and elastic, sock-like cuff supporting the fit. Underfoot, the tooling forgoes a traditional midsole, instead sporting a rubber outsole that climbs up the heel and side wall, offering both traction down below and support up top.

shoeName: adidas Yeezy Boost 350 V2 Cloud White (Non-Reflective)
description: The Yeezy Boost 350 V2 'Cloud White Non-Reflective' launched in September 2019, featuring a two-tone neutral finish on the re-engineered Primeknit upper. In addition to a flexible collar and floating laces, the sneaker makes use of a post-dyed monofilament side stripe on the lateral side, adding a see-through element to the lightweight build. The kicks are supported by a rubber-wrapped Boost midsole.

The Yeezy 700 V3 'Arzareth' brings a series of blue hues to its bold progressive look. Built with breathable knit, the shoe is overlaid by a semitranslucent RPU cage for support. The bootie-style collar contrasts the look in black, while underfoot, the EVA midsole is encapsulated by PU. A herringbone rubber outsole provides traction.

The adidas Yeezy 450 'Stone Marine' is made with a one-piece knit upper, equipped with a ribbed cuff and no-tie laces. The Yeezy logo adorns the Ortholite insoles. The foam midsole has tapered 'fingers' that cradle your feet for enhanced stability. A contoured rubber outsole underfoot has a wavy pattern for sturdy traction.

The adidas Yeezy 450 ‘Stone Flax’ is the epitome of a forward-thinking desigh with all-day comfort. With a Primeknit upper for cushy support, the shoe offers additional comfort via a stretchy cuff collar and 'tendrils' of polyurethane extending from the midsole. Underfoot, grippiness and traction are ensured by the outsole in wavy-patterned rubber.

Drawing similar comparisons to the Yeezy 700 V3 'Safflower' this new 'Mono Safflower' iteration makes small updates to create a new colorway. The upper is crafted with monofilament engineered mesh, featuring a cream base and striated orange lines that span the length of the profile. A semi-translucent RPU glow-in-the-dark cage overlays the shoe, while a PU encapsulated EVA midsole provides lightweight cushioning. The 700 outsole returns, with a classic herringbone pattern in gum rubber.

Pairing an austere color palette with a ventilated build is the adidas Yeezy 500 'Ash Grey.' A neutral greyscale finish is applied to the lifestyle runner, highlighted by an open mesh upper with premium cow suede overlays. A rubber-wrap mudguard gives the shoe abrasion-resistant durability, while 3M reflective piping offers added visibility in low-light conditions. It's built on an adiPRENE+ midsole, rendered in a dark taupe finish and featuring podular construction modeled after adidas' retro Feet You Wear technology.

colorway: Alien Blue RF/Alien Blue RF/Alien Blue RF
description: The Yeezy Boost 380 'Alien Blue' features a subdued colorway on its lifestyle construction. Built with Primeknit, the shoe's upper appears in grey and white, highlighted by reflective detailing throughout. The monofilament window on the side wall adds color in green, while underfoot, a semitranslucent blue rubber cage overlays the full-length Boost midsole, which provides cushioning. The outsole incorporates a herringbone pattern for traction.

The Yeezy Boost 380 'Hylte' emerges with a vibrant look. The shoe's signature construction includes a Primeknit build on the upper, finished in a camouflage-style mix of brown and yellow. The monofilament window highlights the look in bright green, while underfoot, a grey rubber cage contrasts the look and envelopes the Boost midsole. A herringbone rubber outsole offers traction.

Part of the first 350 release in 2019, the Yeezy Boost 350 V2 'Hyperspace' features a neutral colorway. The shoe's flexible Primeknit upper appears in Hyperspace, with a microfilament vent running through design. A heel loop and rope laces support the fit, while underfoot, the translucent midsole reveals a full-length Boost midsole. The shoe released exclusively in select cities in Africa, the Middle East, India and Asia Pacific.

shoeName: adidas Yeezy QNTM BSKTBL Frozen Blue
description: The Yeezy Basketball 'Frozen Blue' brings a vibrant look to Kanye West's basketball-inspired performance shoe. Built with textile knit, the shoe's upper is overlaid by an RPU cage, highlighted by blue throughout. The black neoprene collar includes extra padding, with a seamless heel counter included for stability. Underfoot, a semitranslucent TPU cage overlays the full-length Boost midsole, giving way to a herringbone rubber outsole for traction.

The Yeezy 500 'Enflame' features vibrant tooling on its signature construction. The shoe's upper is built with a mix of open mesh and suede, finished in brown, tan, grey and indigo. A tongue pull-loop is included for easy on and off, while a rubber midfoot wrap bolsters the design. Underfoot, an Adiprene+ midsole provides cushioning and highlights the design in orange, matched underfoot by the rubber outsole, which offers traction.

The adidas Yeezy 450 'Sulfur' has a sock-like knit upper for an adaptive feel. A molded foam-injected midsole is made with tapered 'fingers' that engulf the sides for support and stability, while bringing an eye-catching design.

colorway: Super Moon Yellow/Super Moon Yellow/Super Moon Yellow
description: The Yeezy 500 Super Moon Yellow features adidas ‘Feet You Wear’ technology and a yellow finish on the suede and mesh upper. The initial release was unconventional in that shoppers were able to get their hands on the kicks only if they purchased a bundled option that also included a hoodie and sweat shorts. However, the sneakers released independently a few months later.

The Yeezy Slides 'Enflame Orange' brings a vibrant look to its signature slide construction. The shoe is built entirely with injected EVA, finished in orange and supported by an open toe on the upper for breathability. Three-Stripes appear on the footbed, offering the only exterior branding, while underfoot, the outsole sports flex grooves to provide traction and flexibility.

shoeName: adidas Yeezy Boost 700 MNVN Laceless Phosphor
description: The latest iteration of the Yeezy Boost 700 MNVN showcases a bright Phosphor shade on the upper, which also features a laceless design for easy slip-on convenience. The upper is crafted with a lightweight polyester, contrasted by black no-sew details and large metallic silver '700' branding. A white sculpted midsole returns, housing Boost cushioning while a black rubber outsole ties everything together.

shoeName: adidas Yeezy Knit RNR Boot Sulfur
description: Making its global debut at the Yeezy Season 8 runway show in Paris was the adidas Yeezy Knit Runner Boot 'Sulfur.' Drawing from the low-top Yeezy Knit Runner, the futuristic silhouette features a calf-length canvas collar lined in a waterproof membrane and 150 grams of Thinsulate insulation for added warmth. Velcro closure makes it easy to pull on and off with an upper made from a single piece of knit textile, finished in a deep yellow hue and shored up with a reinforced PU toe. A matching yellow finish is executed on a textured EVA midsole, supported underfoot by a high-traction rubber outsole.

The Nike Air Foamposite Pro Prm 'Yeezy' was released in April 2014, inspired by the 2012 Nike Air Yeezy 2 NRG ' Solar Red ' from Kanye West and features a design combining a black mesh / nubuck upper with a black shell and swoosh. The sneaker also has vivid fluorescent red accents and sits on a translucent green outsole that glows in the dark.

shoeName: adidas Yeezy Knit RNR Stone Carbon
description: Minimal and efficient design has been a hallmark for Kanye West, and the adidas Yeezy Knit Runner is no exception. The laceless sneaker in 'Stone Carbon' is constructed from black knit textile with a contrasting hit of brown near the collar. An EVA midsole is concealed within the knit upper, while a rubber outsole features a modified herringbone pattern for grip. Little details including dual Yeezy and adidas branding on the sockliner, and a tiny size indicator printed on the collar of the shoe near the heel.

A lifestyle iteration of Kanye West's performance basketball shoe, the Yeezy Quantum 'Teal Blue' features vibrant accents throughout its construction. The knit upper emerges in a mix of teal and grey, with tonal suede overlaying the toe. A heel counter is included for stability, while partially concealed laces support the fit. Underfoot, a semitranslucent rubber cage overlays the full-length Boost midsole, which provides cushioning.

Add some color to your slip-on with the adidas Yeezy Slides 'Glow Green'. A monochromatic neon green hue is featured on the build which is made from a single piece of injected EVA foam. Adidas' signature three-stripes is stamped on the top layer of the footbed. On the underfoot are horizontal grooves cut in the outsole which offers both traction and protection.

The Yeezy Boost 750 ‘Chocolate’ sneaker was released following the Yeezy Season 2 presentation at New York Fashion Week 2016. The design combines a light brown nubuck upper with an elastic mid-foot strap, perforated vamp and a gum Boost midsole that glows in the dark. The sneaker also features an upgraded ankle zipper.

A futuristic slip-on built with optimal traction and comfort in mind, the adidas Yeezy Foam Runner Infants ‘Onyx’ is a soft, breathable clog for tiny feet. The textured footbed and sculpted heel deliver a snug, easy fit in this molded one-piece upper built with injected EVA foam. The all-black finish is accented by subtle adidas branding on the outsole.
DISCLAIMER: US and UK sizing is the same and does not require any conversion.

shoeName: adidas Yeezy Foam RNNR MX Cream Clay
colorway: MX Cream Clay/MX Cream Clay/MX Cream Clay
description: The Yeezy Foam Runner 'MX Cream Clay' brings a neutral series of hues to its unique slip-on construction. Built with a mix of EVA and hydroponically produced algae, the shoe's swirling upper includes ventilation ports throughout to provide breathability. Incorporating a sculpted design for support, the upper is anchored underfoot by a rubber outsole with a wavy pattern for traction.

The Yeezy Quantum 'Sea Teal' emerges with a subdued colorway. The lifestyle silhouette is built with knit, finished in black and grey and subtly accented by light teal. The ankle is supported by an elastic collar, with a seamless heel counter included for stability. Underfoot, full-length Boost offers cushioning, encased in a semitranslucent rubber cage and giving way to a gum rubber outsole with a herringbone pattern for traction.

shoeName: adidas Yeezy Powerphase Calabasas Core Black
description: The Yeezy Powerphase Calabasas 'Core Black' was designed by Kanye West and is a minimalist take on the Powerphase sneaker from the 80s. The lateral side is accentuated by the gold 'Calabasas' print and green 'adidas' text alongside a red Trefoil logo, dressed in an all-black leather top with matching laces. The look is completed by a black EVA midsole and rubber outsole. Other colorways included 'Core White' and 'Grey' are released as part of the 'Calabasas' collection.

shoeName: adidas Yeezy 350 V2 CMPCT Slate Carbon
description: Delivered in shades of black, grey and tan, the Yeezy Boost 350 v2 ‘Slate Carbon’ gets an elevated finish with its uniquely patterned Primeknit upper. The slip-on build fastens with no-tie rope laces and a sock-like cuff that ensure freedom of movement alongside low-key support. The sockliner showcases a Yeezy logo, while a full-length Boost midsole provides cushioning, wrapped in a TPU cage and exposed through cut-outs in the rubber outsole.

shoeName: adidas Yeezy 350 V2 CMPCT Slate Red
description: Dressing the sneaker in a saturated crimson hue is the adidas Yeezy Boost 350 V2 CMPCT 'Slate Red.' The Primeknit upper showcases an abstract woven pattern and a lacing system reminiscent of the Yeezy 450. Unlike the original 350 V2, it has an elastic cuff for a more sock-like fit. Responsive cushioning is in the full-length Boost midsole with a dark red rubber cage and a color-matched rubber outsole.

Part of the Yeezy Season 8 lineup that launched in March 2019, the Yeezy Boost 700 'Inertia' features the upper of the original 700. The shoe's heavily paneled build includes a mix of premium suede, mesh and smooth leather, finished in a series of blue hues. The signature bulky midsole is accented by hits of orange at the heel, with a full-length Boost midsole providing cushioning. Underfoot, a patterned outsole with a herringbone tread provides traction.

The Yeezy 500 High 'Tyrian' emerges with a mixed-material build on its bold construction. The shoe's upper sports a blue elastane base overlaid by black leather and brown suede, with a padded collar and tongue supporting the fit. A rubber mudguard is included for durability, while underfoot, a podular adiprene+ midsole provides cushioning. The outsole incorporates a wavy pattern for traction.

shoeName: adidas Yeezy Boost 700 MNVN Honey Flux
description: Made from lightweight yellow polyester is the adidas Yeezy Boost 700 MNVN 'Honey Flux'. A reflective metallic silver '700' is branded on the lateral side with black accents on the padded tongue, no-tie elastic laces, and no-sew overlays with more reflective detailing. The midsole is made with polyurethane and houses full-length Boost cushioning. The rubber outsole features a herringbone traction pattern for a better grip.

shoeName: adidas Yeezy Boost 350 V2 Ash Blue
description: The Yeezy Boost 350 V2 'Ash Blue' features a neutral look on its signature construction. The shoe's upper is built with re-engineered Primeknit, finished in a mix of blue, grey and black, with a yellow monofilament stripe cutting through the side wall. Underfoot, a full-length Boost midsole wrapped in a semitranslucent rubber cage provides cushioning, giving way to a rubber outsole for traction.
Yeezy Foam RNR Kids IG5352

shoeName: adidas Yeezy BSKTBL Knit Slate Onyx
description: Yeezy BSKTBL Knit HQ6762

Dropping in August 2019, the Yeezy 500 ‘Bone White’ features a subtle monochromatic finish on the layered upper, constructed from a blend of cow suede, premium leather and breathable mesh. Reflective detailing around the eyelets, tongue and mudguard piping offer added visibility in low-light conditions, while adidas’ adiPRENE cushioning delivers a smooth ride.

Debuting in Paris during the Yeezy Season 8 runway show in March 2020 is the adidas Yeezy NSLTD Boot 'Khaki.' A monochrome tan hue suffuses the hybrid silhouette built for the winter season it features a puffy textile upper in a mid-calf height. Velcro closure on the lateral side makes it easy to take on and off. It's built on sculpted foam tooling that recalls the Yeezy Foam Runner, complete with flowing lines and a trio of large ventilation ports.

With the launch of their Yeezy PowerPhase Calabasas, which launched in this understated grey colorway in December 2017, Kanye West and adidas took their collaborative line in a decidedly retro-inspired direction. The versatile low-top is made of soft leather, finished in a gray dusty shade which also covers the die-cut EVA midsole and rubber outsole of the shoe. The quarter panel features three-strip perforated, a logo window with adidas trefoil branding, and gold foil lettering ' CALABASAS. '

Unveiled at Madison Square Garden's Yeezy Season 3 presentation, the 350 V2 ' Beluga ' Yeezy Boost dropped on September 24, 2016. The evolved Yeezy Boost 350 V2 silhouette features a two-tone gray Primeknit and a laterally branded solar red stripe with SPLY-350. The midfoot suede panel was removed on the medial side and the pull tab was replaced by a new elastic fit.

Secured with no-tie shoelaces, the adidas Yeezy 500 Kids 'Stone Salt' uses light grey mesh with matching leather and suede overlays. These kids' shoes are piped with a reflective finish, complemented by a seamless rubber mudguard. The grey adiPRENE+ midsole sports a podular structure modeled after the adidas KB8 3.

The Yeezy Quantum 'Barium' is a performance basketball shoe with a neutral look. Built with Primeknit, the upper sports a jacquard design overlaid by an RPU cage and synthetic suede at the toe cap. An external heel counter provides stability, bolstering the inner bootie construction. Underfoot, a Boost midsole and gum rubber outsole provide cushioning and traction.

shoeName: adidas Yeezy Foam RNNR MX Sand Grey
colorway: MX Sand Grey/MX Sand Grey/MX Sand Grey
description: The adidas Yeezy Foam Runner 'MX Sand Grey' blends three neutral colors across a one-piece foam upper. An understated tan shade anchors the palette, with swirling accents of grey and dark beige on the heel, side panels and outsole. Ventilation ports lend the shoe a dynamic appearance and offer breathable comfort. A wavy traction pattern underfoot provides enhanced grip, with a sculpted heel designed to cradle the back of the foot.

The adidas Yeezy 450 Slide 'White' is a slip-on constructed from a single piece of lightweight and sturdy EVA foam with a breathable, open-web design that wraps around the foot for proper ventilation. The cushioned midsole smoothly transitions into a contoured outsole that is adorned with a wavy traction pattern. Subtle debossed adidas branding appears on the footbed’s soft top layer.

The Yeezy Boost 380 'Calcite Glow' features a neutral look with an unexpected accent. Built with Primeknit, the upper appears in white and grey, highlighted by a glow-in-the-dark camouflage detailing throughout. A monofilament window cuts through the side wall, while a sock-like collar supports the fit. Underfoot, the Boost in the midsole provides cushioning, with an elevated construction at the heel.

shoeName: adidas Yeezy Knit RNR Fade Indigo
