description: The adidas lineup gets a new color update with the Yeezy Knit Runner ‘Fade Indigo.’ The austere lines in fading knit blues, greens and violet partner with a blue cuff in stretch textile that helps ensure close-fitting easy wear. The rubber outsole in brown features grippy herringbone tread.

DISCLAIMER: US and UK sizing is the same and does not require any conversion.

The adidas Yeezy Slide Resin is made of Resin EVA foam throughout the design to provide lightweight durability. From there, a soft footbed offers an immediate step in comfort. An outsole with accentuated grooves for traction and support wraps the design.

The adidas Yeezy Slide Resin released in April of 2021 and retailed for $60.

The Yeezy 500 High 'Sumac' emerges with a rustic colorway on its bulky construction. Built with mesh, the shoe's upper sports a brown base, supported by tonal suede at the toe and heel. Blue suede at the midfoot complements the design, while red on the collar and eyestay highlights the look. A rubber mudguard bolsters the fit, while underfoot, podular Adiprene+ is included for cushioning. A tonal rubber outsole offers traction.

The adidas Yeezy Boost 350 V2 Infants 'Bone' has a chalk white knit upper accented with a post-dyed monofilament side stripe and center stitch details. No-tie elastic laces work alongside a heel pull tab for easy on and off. A full-length Boost midsole is wrapped in a see-through cage, anchored by a rubber outsole.

The debut colorway of Kanye West's sock-like silhouette, which exclusively launched through Yeezy Supply site, is the adidas Yeezy Knit Runner 'Sulfur'. The full knit build features a neutral tan shade with a contrasting mustard yellow finish throughout the upper and has a slip-on construction devoid on the lateral collar. It's built on a durable rubber outsole in a matching yellow finish and features a modified herringbone tread and adidas branding under the heel.
Yeezy Desert Boot Infant EG6683

Updating the minimalist slip-on silhouette with a monochrome black finish is the adidas Yeezy Slide Infants 'Onyx.' The one-piece build is made with injected EVA foam with adjustable straps wrapped around the heel for a secure fit. adidas' three-stripe branding is debossed on the footbed, featuring a soft top layer. Deep grooves are built into the outsole for better traction and improved shock absorption.

A regional exclusive release, the Yeezy Boost 350 V2 'Synth Reflective' released alongside a non-reflective iteration. The shoe's upper features a Primeknit construction, finished in a patterned two-tone look and accented by reflective detailing throughout. The signature monofilment stripe runs through the upper, but the siganture heel loop is absent. Undefoot, a full-length Boost midsole is wrapped by a TPU shell that continues down onto the rubber outsole.

A neutral look, the Yeezy Boost 350 V2 'Linen' is highlighted by reflective detailing on its signature post-dyed monofilament stripe. The rest of the upper appears in Linen on its Primeknit construction. Contrast is provided by the collar, while underfoot, a semitranslucent rubber cage overlays the Boost midsole. A gum rubber outsole provides traction.

The Yeezy Boost 380 'Alien' represents the debut colorway of Kanye West’s Yeezy 350 follow-up. The lifestyle sneaker makes use of a patterned Primeknit upper, equipped with floating laces, a sock-like collar and perforated detailing for added breathability. The lightweight construction sits atop a semi-translucent rubber midsole, housing adidas Boost for responsive cushioning.

The Yeezy Boost 350 V2 GID 'Glow' features a glow-in-the-dark finish throughout its Primeknit upper. The signature design includes a translucent monofilament stripe for the only contrast, as the rope laces and heel pull-loop are worked tonally into the construction. Underfoot, a Boost midsole is encased in a Tubular sole unit to support the fit.

Featuring a subdued colorway, the Yeezy Boost 380 'Yecoraite' emerges with a camouflage-style mix of white and grey throughout its Primeknit construction. Decorative laces add to the aesthetic, while a translucent monofilament window provides contrast. Underfoot, the full-length Boost midsole is overlaid by a semitranslucent rubber cage, giving way to an orange herringbone rubber outsole for traction.

The Yeezy Boost 700 'Sun' brings a pastel look to its running construction. Featuring a layered design, the shoe's upper is built with mesh and leather, overlaid by suede and finished in a mix of yellow, blue, teal and black. Underfoot, an orange midsole complements the design, incorporating drop-in Boost to provide cushioning. The rubber outsole includes a herringbone pattern for traction.

The Yeezy 500 ‘Stone’ showcases an unassuming neutral colorway on an upper built with a combination of cow suede and premium leather. Details include reflective piping for add visibility in low-light conditions and a sculpted midsole with adidas adiPRENE+ cushioning for impact absorption and a smooth ride. A gum rubber outsole provides durable traction underfoot.

shoeName: adidas Yeezy Boost 750 Light Grey Glow In the Dark
description: The Yeezy Boost 750 ' Glow in the Dark ' dropped on 11 June 2016 and features a light gray nubuck top with an elastic midfoot strap. It is also fitted with a zipper for easy entry, perforated vamp and a glow in the dark gum Boost midsole.

The Adidas Yeezy Quantum 'Mono Carbon' offers a muted color scheme on a basketball-style design. The upper is made from a combination of materials, including a flexible neoprene collar and a woven mesh base, decorated with grey and off-white wave-like accents. The toe is reinforced with synthetic suede, and the heel has a counter with reflective qualities that also provides stability. The shoe is equipped with a full-length Boost midsole that is encased in a semi-clear TPU shell and its rubber outsole features a herringbone-patterned tread for traction.

The adidas Yeezy Slide Kids 'Slate Marine' sports a grey foam upper, with a molded footbed that includes a debossed three-stripe logo. A cushy midsole makes way to a serrated outsole, which has strategically-placed horizontal grooves to keep their feet comfortable with every step.

The Yeezy 700 V3 'Safflower' emerges with a neutral look on its progressive construction. The shoe's monofilament mesh upper includes striated detailing throughout its design, with a glow-in-the-dark RPU cage that runs the length of the shoe. A black inner bootie and tonal laces support the fit, while underfoot, the EVA midsole is encased in PU, with an exaggerated build at the heel. A rubber outsole is included for traction.

The adidas Yeezy Boost 350 V2 Infants 'Onyx' dons a black Primeknit upper with center stitch details and a post-dyed side stripe. Elastic no-tie laces and a heel pull tab allow for easy on and off. A full-length Boost midsole works with partially see-through sidewalls to complete the look.

shoeName: adidas Yeezy Boost 350 V2 Lundmark (Non Reflective)
description: The Yeezy Boost 350 V2 'Lundmark Non-Reflective' brings a neutral look to the 350 silhouette. The shoe's Primeknit upper works a mix of Cream and black into its construction, accented by a monofilament stripe across the design. The signature heel strap is absent, but the tooling remains intact, with a Boost midsole overlaid by semi-transparent rubber that continues down onto the outsole.

The Yeezy Boost 700 Kids 'Wave Runner,' originally revealed at the Season 5 runway show, emerges here in kids' sizes. The shoe maintains the look of its full-size counterparts, with a mesh upper in Solid Grey and teal overlaid by suede and leather in Solid Grey and black. The breathable build is accented by neon laces, while underfoot, the colorful midsole houses a Boost unit for cushioning. A herringbone pattern on the outsole provides traction.

An infants' iteration of the Yeezy Boost 700, the Yeezy Boost 700 V2 Infant 'Wave Runner' features the same bold look as its full-size counterpart. The shoe's upper sports a mesh base in Solid Grey and teal, with Solid Grey and black suede throughout the design. Neon laces accent the look, with a perforated heel counter for stability. Underfoot, the bulky midsole houses a Boost unit for cushioning, with a herringbone pattern on the outsole for traction.

shoeName: adidas Yeezy Boost 350 V2 Core Black Green
description: The Yeezy Boost 350 V2 Green combines SPLY 350 branding, a translucent black midsole, and a black upper with a green stripe. It was released in a pack alongside the ‘Copper’ and ‘Red’ in November 2016.

With a Primeknit upper paneled in suede and neoprene, the adidas Yeezy Quantum ‘Hi-Res Coral’ is a futuristic silhouette delivered in soft pastels. The shoe's RPU cage displays undulating lines in pale yellow against the upper in see-through jacquard mesh. Suede at the toe in pale coral and light green neoprene in the collar and heel pair with the bright orange hues of the outsole. Branding is subtle; the bootie and laces in light green are unadorned and YEEZY Globe branding is only visible on the insoles.

The trail-ready adidas Yeezy 500 High ‘Taupe Black’ features a dark olive, black and brown palette in elastane, suede and leather. Underfoot, comfort and traction are ensured with a Charcoal Grey mudguard and an adiPRENE+ sole unit. Reflective piping and no-tie laces round out the details of this hiking-inspired lifestyle shoe.

shoeName: adidas Yeezy Boost 350 V2 Core Black Red (Kids)
description: The Yeezy Boost 350 V2 Kids 'Red' brings back a well-known dual-color scheme for Yeezy Day 2022. Its secure fit is ensured with no-tie laces and the black Primeknit upper boasts unique stitching across the center front. The bright crimson stripe on the outer side showcases the iconic SPLY-350 branding. The shoe is equipped with a full-length Boost midsole that offers responsive cushioning and is protected by a black TPU wrap for added toughness and stability. Underfoot, the rubber outsole provides excellent traction for any activity.

shoeName: adidas Yeezy Boost 350 V2 Static Reflective
description: The Yeezy Boost 350 V2 ‘Static Reflective' shows off the same style as the 'Static' colorway, but uses reflective highlights in the Primeknit yarns. The other accents are similar to the 'Static', including an icy side stripe and 3M reflective hits on the shoe’s rope laces, Primeknit upper, and Three-Stripes branding on the interior heel. The midsole is outfitted with ridged TPU sidewalls that are semi-translucent, revealing full-length adidas Boost cushioning within. The 350 V2 'Static Reflective' is exclusive to Yeezy Supply.

The Yeezy Foam Runner 'Ararat' debuted at London Fashion Week 2020 before releasing the following June. The slip-on construction is built with a mix of lightweight EVA and harvested algae to create a unique compound, sporting a series of sculpted lines and a monochromatic look. Oval cutouts throughout provide breathability.

A dark palette made up of black, brown, and grey tones is featured on the adidas Yeezy Boost 380 'Stone Slate.' The colors are applied to a re-engineered Primeknit upper with no-tie laces and an elastic sock-like cuff. Translucent monofilament windows across the side panels as a see-through element. The lightweight build is on a full-length Boost midsole, entirely wrapped in a smoky rubber cage and supported by a herringbone-traction rubber outsole.

The Yeezy Boost 350 V2 'Marsh' emerges with a subdued look. Built with Primeknit, the upper appears primarily in Marsh, with darker yellow on the collar and grey on the signature monofilament stripe. Underfoot, a semitranslucent rubber shell overlays a Boost midsole for cushioning.

The Yeezy 500 High 'Tactical Orange' emerges with a largely subdued look on its signature construction. The shoe's upper is built with mesh, finished in brown and complemented by blue suede on the overlays. A padded, high-cut collar works with the plush tongue for comfort, while the fit is supported by a brown rubber mudguard. Underfoot, a podular Adiprene+ midsole offers cushioning, giving way to a more vibrant finish on the rubber outsole, which offers traction.

A vibrant look, the Yeezy Boost 380 'Blue Oat Non-Reflective' features a Primeknit construction on the upper. Finished in a stylized mix of orange and beige, the monofilament window accents the look in blue. Perforations provide breathability, while underfoot, a Boost midsole is overlaid by a semitranslucent cage. A gum rubber outsole is included for traction.

In a February 2015 interview with New York's Power 105.1 FM, Kanye teased the Yeezy Boost 750 ' Black ' colorway. Later, he was found in a New York Fashion Week with a black suede / gum sole version. Released on 19 December 2015, the 'Black' sneaker features complete suede upper, perforated cap and ankle Zipper, as the second colorway of the Yeezy Boost 750 line.

The adidas Yeezy Boost 700 V2 'Mauve' is a continuation of the original 'Mauve' colorway of the Yeezy Boost 700. This sneaker has a textured mesh upper with seamless skins along the quarter panel. Greenish-grey suede is present along the shoe and a full Boost midsole is fitted in a polyurethane carrier. On the bottom is a herringbone-traction rubber outsole.

The adidas Yeezy Boost 350 V2 Kids 'Onyx' has a laceless, black Primeknit upper adorned by a post-dyed monofilament side stripe. A heel pull tab allows for easy on and off. A partially-caged Boost midsole keeps every step soft and comfortable, paired with a rubber outsole underfoot.

The Yeezy Boost 380 'Pepper Reflective' emerges with a neutral look on its signature construction. The shoe's upper is built with Primeknit, finished in a camouflage-style mix of neutral hues. Reflective fibers woven into the design accent the look while providing visibility, with a post-dyed monofilament stripe cutting through the side wall. Underfoot, a rubber cage overlays the full-length Boost midsole, which provides cushioning.

Kanye West's one-piece slip-on design is both futuristic and practical. Crafted with injected foam into one single piece, the Yeezy Foam Runner 'Mist' arrives in an all-over tan finish. Sculpted lines across the upper compliment the ventilation holes, providing breathability and structure to the slide. Underfoot, a contoured outsole features a wavy traction pattern for grip.

The adidas Yeezy Boost 350 V2 Kids 'Static' was released on Yeezy Day 2022 and features a unique weave pattern in white and grey tones on the Primeknit upper. The design is simple, with a semi-translucent stripe on the side for improved ventilation. The heel has a convenient pull tab and the laces are elastic, making the shoe easy to put on and take off. The shoe is protected by a TPU cage and provides responsive cushioning through the full-length Boost midsole.

The Yeezy Desert Boot “Rock” in kids’ sizing is all set for whatever life throws at you. Styled in a monotone Rock colorway, these boots look ready for a desert adventure or any terrain. The all-tan upper is made of breathable mesh to keep things fresh, with stylish suede accenting the construction. A single grey stripe adorns a stripe along the tongue that leads to a loop for easy on-and-off. A tan rubber outsole and midsole provide grip from the streets to the playground.

shoeName: adidas Yeezy Foam RNR MX Cinder (Infants)
description: Step into celebrated comfort with the YZY Foam RNR "Cinder". This futuristic shoe features a lightweight EVA foam construction in a unique, deep brown-grey color. The sculpted design and numerous ventilation ports deliver superior cushioning, making it the perfect choice for making a bold, sophisticated statement with everyday ease.

The Yeezy Slides 'Earth Brown' brings a neutral monochromatic look to its bold slide construction. Built with EVA foam, the one-piece upper is supported underfoot by a molded footbed for comfort. The outsole sports a series of exaggerated flex grooves to provide flexible traction on the slip-on build.
Yeezy Desert Boot Infant EG6684

The Yeezy Boost 700 'Magnet' showcases varying shades of grey on the upper, constructed from a blend of textile with leather and suede overlays. Reflective detailing at the heel provides added visibility in low-light conditions, while full-length Boost cushioning offers a smooth ride. The sneaker’s sculpted midsole is accented with pops of orange and reinforced by a gum rubber outsole.

Accented with special details crafted specifically for Kanye, the Air Yeezy 2 NRG ‘Solar Red’ shares a familiar color palette with its Air Yeezy ‘Blink’ predecessor, though the newer model stands out with a more refined silhouette. One feature carried over from the original Air Yeezy is the glow-in-the-dark outsole, which is lifted from the Air Challenge II. The sneaker also includes a molded rubber heel, anaconda textured side panel, and Egyptology references on the tongue and midfoot strap.

Stretchy no-tie laces and a heel pull tab let you put them on or take them off. A full-length Boost midsole is housed inside a ribbed cage, visible only through a tiny window on the rubber outsole.

shoeName: adidas Yeezy Boost 700 V2 Hospital Blue
description: The Yeezy Boost 700 V2 'Hospital Blue' applies monochromatic coloring to the silhouette’s signature layered look. The upper makes use of durable heavy-gauge canvas with tonal suede overlays and reflective detailing throughout. A full-length drop-in Boost midsole delivers lightweight and responsive cushioning, while the herringbone-tread rubber outsole is good for durable traction underfoot.

shoeName: adidas Yeezy Boost 380 Blue Oat Reflective
description: The Yeezy Boost 380 'Blue Oat Reflective' emerges with a vibrant look. The shoe's upper is built with Primeknit, finished in a camo-like mix of orange and brown, with blue on the monofilament window. Reflective detailing is worked into the construction, while underfoot, a semitranslucent rubber cage houses a Boost midsole for cushioning, partially visible through the outsole.

Featuring an entirely neutral color scheme and highlighted by different shades of grey in the Primeknit upper is the adidas Yeezy Boost 380 'Pyrite.' The sock-like build has no-tie laces and a side panel with translucent monofilament windows woven in, allowing more airflow. Caged boost cushioning is featured on the midsole with a herringbone-traction rubber outsole.

With distinctive design touches, the adidas Yeezy Boost 350 V2 'Yeezreel' is an audacious retool of the Kanye West-designed sneaker. Dropped in December 2019, this variant utilizes reflective threads woven into the duo-colored neon Primeknit upper and rope laces. A post-dyed monofilament side stripe streaks across the lateral. Full-length Boost cushioning engineering peeks through the glow-in-the-dark midsole and rubber sole unit underneath.

The adidas Yeezy Slide Kids “Pure” is the kids sizing of the popular slip-on sandal by Kanye West. Brought back by adidas for a second time in December 2021, the first release being in April 2021, the “Pure” is complete with a beige, lightweight EVA foam body for maximum comfort whether traversing through the city streets or poolside. The midfoot arch provides a lockdown fit and the ridged outsole ensures grip on wet surfaces. Release date: December 13, 2021

The Yeezy Desert Boot “Oil” in kids’ sizing is made for any and all adventures. With an entirely black construction, these boots are both stylish for everyday wear, and functional for traversing any terrain. The all-black upper is made of breathable mesh to keep things fresh, with stylish suede accenting the construction. A single gray stripe adorns a strip along the tongue that leads to a loop for easy on-and-off. An all-black rubber outsole and midsole provide grip from the streets to the playground.

The Yeezy Boost 350 V2 'Fade' features a patterned look on its signature construction. The shoe's upper is built with Primeknit, finished in a mix of brown and beige and bisected by a monofilament stripe through the side wall. Underfoot, a full-length Boost midsole provides cushioning, overlaid by a rubber cage that gives way to a rubber outsole for traction.

shoeName: adidas Yeezy BSKTBL Knit Slate Azure
description: The adidas Yeezy Basketball Knit arrives in a 'Slate Azure' colorway, featuring a bold blue accent on the front of the toe and outsole. The rest of the Primeknit upper is made up of different weaves in light grey, while an extended ankle cuff provides a sock-like custom fit. A full-length Boost unit is embedded in the midsole for lightweight cushioning, while a TPU heel counter helps with durability and support.

Built from mixed-material of flexible elastane and reinforced overlays in cow suede and tumbled leather is the adidas Yeezy 500 High 'Mist Stone.' It features contrasting hits of black on the padded tongue and toggle lace closure with a high-cut collar for a more secured fit. A rubber wrap along the base of the upper gives into a cream-colored adiPRENE midsole and has a podular construction modeled after adidas' retro Feet You Wear technology.

shoeName: adidas Yeezy Foam RNNR Mineral Blue
description: A progressive slip-on, the Yeezy Foam Runner 'Mineral Blue' emerges with a monochromatic look. Built with foam, the shoe's Mineral Blue upper includes ventilation ports throughout, allowing for breathability and less weight. A raised heel promotes a more natural stride, while underfoot, the outsole sports a wavy pattern for traction, also revealing the only branding via an adidas logo.

shoeName: adidas Yeezy Foam RNNR MXT Moon Gray
description: The Yeezy Foam Runner 'MXT Moon Grey' brings a neutral two-tone look to its bold construction. The one-piece silhouette emerges with a swirling mix of grey and off-white throughout its build, which incorporates EVA and an algae-based foam. Ventilation ports are included to provide breathability, with a textured interior supporting the fit. Underfoot, a herringbone outsole provides traction.

The Yeezy Boost 700 V2 'Geode' features reflective accents on its neutral colorway. The shoe's upper is built with a mix of mesh, premium leather and rich suede, finished primarily in Geode and black. Reflective detailing on the laces, quarter panel and heel provides visibility in low-light conditions, while underfoot, the bulky midsole houses a full-length Boost unit for cushioning. A gum rubber outsole provides traction while offering an elevated finish.

The adidas Yeezy Boost 700 V2 Kids 'Static' was introduced as part of Yeezy Day 2022. It features an upper in grey knit with overlays in nubuck and a leather mudguard in off-white. The laces, webbing eyelets, and quarter-panel detailing feature reflective accents for improved visibility in low-light conditions. The shoe stays true to the original 700 model, with a full-length Boost cushioning and molded TPU sidewalls. The rubber outsole is equipped with a herringbone-patterned tread to ensure optimal traction underfoot.

colorway: Alien Blue RF/Alien Blue RF/Alien Blue RF
description: Released in May 2021, the Yeezy Boost 380 Kids 'Alien Blue' features a look similar to 2019's debut 'Alien' colorway. The shoe's upper is built with reengineered Primeknit, which sports a camouflage-style mix of white and grey. Green accents the monofilament window on the side wall, while no-tie laces secure the fit. Underfoot, a full-length Boost midsole in a rubber cage provides cushioning, giving way to a herringbone rubber outsole for traction.

shoeName: adidas Yeezy Boost 350 V2 Beluga Reflective (Kids)
description: Reviving a 2016 colorway with a slight design upgrade is the adidas Yeezy Boost 350 V2 Kids 'Beluga Reflective.' Similar to the original release, it features a marled grey Primeknit upper with an orange side stripe embellished with SPLY-350 branding. Reflective threads are woven into the flexible knit to be better seen at night. It's built on a Boost midsole wrapped in a semi-translucent rubber cage.

shoeName: adidas Yeezy Boost 350 V2 Black Red (Infants)
description: The Yeezy Boost 350 V2 Infant ' Bred, ' dropped on 11 February 2017, combines a black primeknit upper with a red SPLY 350 brand and a full-length boost in the black translucent midsole.

The Yeezy PowerPhase 'Clear Brown' dropped in September 2019 alongside companion colorways in ‘Simple Brown’ and ‘Quiet Grey.’ Like its counterparts, this pair makes use of an all-suede upper entirely finished in a muted hue. The retro-inspired silhouette is embellished with throwback branding hits, including perforated three-stripes, gold-foil CALABASAS print and an adidas trefoil logo window on the eyestay.

shoeName: adidas Yeezy Foam RNNR MX Cream Clay (Kids)
colorway: MX Cream Clay/MX Cream Clay/MX Cream Clay
description: A kids' iteration of the bold silhouette, the Yeezy Foam Runner Kids 'MX Cream Clay' sports unique styling on its unique construction. The shoe is built with a mix of injected EVA and algae, with a swirling finish throughout and ventilation ports offering breathability. The sculpted build is supported underfoot by a wavy pattern on the outsole, which provides traction.

The Yeezy Boost 700 MNVN 'Orange' brings a vibrant look to a shoe that released exclusively in Los Angeles and Paris. The upper is built with nylon instead of the usual mixed-material build, bolstered by heat-welded overlays. The orange look is accented by reflective 700 branding on the lateral side, which replaces the Three-Stripes. Underfoot, a Boost midsole provides cushioning, with a herringbone pattern providing traction.

The Yeezy Boost 700 ‘Teal Blue’ delivers a subtle colorway of the statement-making silhouette, featuring an upper constructed from grey mesh with navy and teal suede overlays. A full-length drop-in Boost midsole delivers lightweight cushioning, while reflective detailing adds visibility in low-light conditions. A gum rubber outsole is good for durable traction underfoot.

shoeName: adidas Yeezy Boost 350 V2 Dazzling Blue (Infants)
description: Arriving in toddler sizing, the adidas Yeezy Boost 350 V2 Infants 'Dazzling Blue' updates the lifestyle silhouette with a black Primeknit upper, featuring a snug, sock-like structure made with adidas' advanced digital knitting technology. A streak of royal blue on the lateral side is accompanied by signature SPLY-350 branding. On the bottom is a full-length Boost midsole wrapped in a semi-translucent TPU cage and a ribbed rubber outsole.

shoeName: adidas Yeezy 350 V2 CMPCT Slate Blue
description: Slate Blue' is the debut colorway of the adidas Yeezy Boost 350 V2 CMPCT, a modified version of the 350 V2. The Primeknit upper features an updated no-tie lacing system and an elastic sock-like cuff, allowing for easy on and off. Shades of grey and navy dominate the low-top, with Yeezy branding limited to the custom sockliner. A full-length Boost midsole provides responsive cushioning, while a semi-translucent gum rubber cage adds improved support and durability.

DISCLAIMER: US and UK sizing is the same and does not require any conversion.

The adidas Yeezy Slide Core is composed of a Core EVA foam throughout the design to provide lightweight comfort. From there, a soft footbed offers cushioning. An outsole with accentuated grooves for traction and support completes the design.

The adidas Yeezy Slide Core released in April of 2021 and retailed for $60.

The Yeezy Boost 350 V2 'Lundmark Reflective' dropped in June 2019 as part of a regional-exclusive release, made available only to customers in North and South America. The shoe's upper is built with Primeknit, finished in off-white and black, a neutral colorway that's accented by reflective detialing. The shoe forgoes the usual wrap around the heel, while underfoot, a Boost midsole provides cushioning. The midsole is wrapped by semi-translucent rubber that continues onto the outsole for traction.

A neutral look, the Yeezy Boost 350 V2 'Yeshaya Reflective' highlights its construction through reflective detailing. The effect is achieved through fibers woven into the build, with further reflective hits on the rope laces and Three-Stripes. A monofilament stripe runs through the construction, while underfoot, a semitranslucent rubber midsole houses a Boost unit for cushioning.

shoeName: adidas Yeezy BSKTBL Knit Slate Blue
description:
Representing the debut colorway of Kanye West's new hoops shoe is the adidas Yeezy Basketball Knit 'Slate Blue.' The Primeknit upper features varying shades of blue that are secured with rope laces and a stretchy high-cut collar that gives a more snug fit. Rearfoot support is provided by a prominent heel counter borrowed from the Yeezy Quantum. The knit is built on a full-length Boost midsole, wrapped in a semi-translucent cage and reinforced by a herringbone-traction rubber outsole.

Runs small, order a half size up.

The Yeezy 500 High 'Wakaran' brings a subdued colorway to its signature construction, which features tooling drawn from Kobe Bryant's KB8 3. The shoe's upper is built with elastane, overlaid by suede and leather and supported by a padded collar. Reflective piping accents the design, while underfoot, the podular Adiprene+ midsole provides cushioning, with a wavy traction pattern on the rubber outsole offering traction.

shoeName: adidas Yeezy Boost 350 V2 Desert Sage (Infants)
description: The Yeezy Boost 350 V2 Infant 'Desert Sage' is an infants' shoe. The shoe's knit upper features a neutral Desert Sage finish, with a classic monofilament window that includes reflective threads. An orange collar lining accents the look, while underfoot, a Boost midsole is overlaid by a semitranslucent rubber shell.

The Yeezy Boost 380 'Mist Reflective' features a neutral camouflage-style print on its signature construction. Built with Primeknit, the upper includes reflective yarns woven directly into the design for visbility in low-light conditions. Underfoot, a semitranslucent rubber cage overlays the Boost midsole, which gives way to a gum rubber outsole for traction.

The Yeezy Boost 380 'Azure Reflective' features a largely neutral look highlighted by a vibrant accent. The shoe's upper is built with Primeknit, finished in brown and sporting reflective fibers woven into the construction. The monofilament window highlights the look in blue, while underfoot, a full-length Boost midsole provides cushioning, wrapped in a semitranslucent rubber cage. The outsole incorporates a herringbone pattern for traction, and the shoe released exclusively in Europe.

The Yeezy Boost 350 V2 Kids 'Clay' released in March 2019, the first time a 350 would be released in adult, kid and infant sizes. This kids' version cuts the adult iteration down to size, with a Primeknit upper in Clay and a microfilament strip cutting through the upper. An orange heel strap supports the fit, while underfoot, the translucent Boost midsole provides cushioning, giving way to a rubber outsole for traction.

The adidas Yeezy Boost 350 V2 Infant is a child-friendly version of Kanye West's revolutionary design, which was first introduced in September 2016. The Citrin version was unveiled in September 2019, sporting a non-glossy Primeknit upper with an uneven stitch design, combined lacing, and a post-dyed clear stripe on the outer side. The shoe is finished with a two-tone sole that incorporates Boost technology for added energy with every stride.

Hitting store shelves in September 2019, the Yeezy Boost 700 V2 'Inertia' mixes pale blue and grey hues on the upper, which is constructed from knit textile with leather and suede overlays for a complex, layered look. Reflective details deliver added visibility in low-light conditions, while a full-length drop in Boost midsole is good for lightweight and responsive cushioning.

shoeName: adidas Yeezy Boost 350 V2 Cream White (Infants)
description: The Yeezy Boost 350 V2 Infant's Cream White, first released on April 29, 2017, combines a cream Primeknit upper with SPLY 350 Tonal Cream branding and a white translucent midsole.

Houston Texans Wide Receiver DeAndre Hopkins was fined $6,000 for wearing the Yeezy 350 Cleat ‘Turtle Dove’ and the cleats were banned due to them not having one dominant base color. The cleat is a reinterpretation of the original Yeezy Boost 350 ‘Turtle Dove.’

The adidas Yeezy Slide Infant “Pure” is the baby sizing of Kanye West’s earth tone slip-on sandal. The “Pure” features a beige-colored lightweight EVA foam construction for maximum comfort. An adjustable heel strap added to the baby sizing wraps around the back of the foot for a more secure fit. The midfoot arch stabilizes the foot and the ridged outsole provides grip on slippery surfaces.

A monochrome colorway of Kanye West's sneaker-sandal hybrid is featured on the adidas Yeezy Foam Runner Infants 'Vermillion.' It's sustainably built in part with harvested algae and features sculpted lines with a deep crimson finish. Ventilation ports throughout the vamp and side panels offer more airflow, while a textured insole keeps the foot locked in place. On the bottom is a contoured outsole with a wavy traction pattern.

A monochromatic look, the Yeezy Slides 'Desert Sand' features a bold slide construction. The shoe's one-piece construction is built with EVA foam, finished entirely in Desert Sand. A soft layer cushions the footbed, while the outsole incorporates prominent horizontal grooves for traction.

shoeName: adidas Yeezy Boost 350 V2 Core Black Copper
description: The Yeezy Boost 350 V2 Red combines SPLY 350 branding, a translucent black midsole, and a black upper with a red stripe. It was released in a pack alongside the ‘Copper’ and ‘Green’ in November 2016.

With military-inspired tactical design, the adidas Yeezy Desert Boot Kids takes cues from street style for this modern revamp. Released in October 2019, this edition embraces a tech mesh upper, suede panels, and leather accents in a minimalistic Salt color palette. A webbing tab emerges and disappears from under the coordinated lacing system. The sneaker's finishing touch is provided by a secure, comfortable midsole and robust rubber outsole.

Launched in June 2012, the Air Yeezy 2 NRG 'Pure Platinum' features a subdued colorway that blends varying shades of grey on the upper and a contrasting pop of bright red on the collar lining. The snakeskin texture on the side panels and prominent ridges on the molded rubber heel serve to elevate the design. Using the Air Tech Challenge II midsole to keep the shoe grounded in the heritage of the Swoosh, the unique design allows it to straddle the line between sport and fashion.

Yeezy mixes it up with the adidas Yeezy Slides Kids 'Glow Green.' With fluorescent green vibrately throughout the sandal and EVA foam that makes it longer lasting and light. The simple design strays away from any other branding but the Three Stripes on the footbed. Stay gripped on the ground with horizontal grooves built on the outsole.

The Yeezy Boost 350 ' Pirate Black ' has a blackened-gray pirate upper with branded suede pads, colored dark gray rope laces, red accented heel tabs and a black boost outsole released on 22 August 2015.

The Yeezy Slides Kids 'Bone' brings a neutral look to its slip-on construction. Built with molded EVA foam, the shoe appears entirely in Bone, while a contoured footbed is included for comfort. The heel of the footbed sports the only exterior branding via Three-Stripes, while the outsole includes deep horizontal grooves to provide flexible traction.

Launching in September 2019, the Yeezy PowerPhase 'Simple Brown' features a monochromatic earth-tone finish on an all-suede upper. Details include perforated three-stripes, gold-foil CALABASAS branding and a retro adidas logo window on the lateral eyestay. The low-top rests atop matching brown tooling, made up of a die-cut EVA midsole and high-abrasion rubber outsole.

The Yeezy Slides 'Bone' features a monochromatic look on its everday slide construction. Built with EVA, the shoe's one-piece build includes a soft layer atop the footbed, which sports the only branding via Three-Stripes on the heel. Underfoot, the outsole sports a series of exaggerated horizontal grooves for traction.

The Yeezy Boost 380 'Lmnte Reflective' features a neutral mix of hues on its signature construction. The shoe's Primeknit upper features a camouflage-style design, highlighted by the yellow monofilament window that cuts through the side wall. Reflective detailing is included for visibility in low-light conditions, while underfoot, a full-length Boost midsole inside a rubber cage provides cushioning.

shoeName: adidas Yeezy Boost 350 V2 True Form
description: The Yeezy Boost 350 V2 'True Form' was one of the first 350 colorways released in 2019. The shoe's flexible Primeknit upper appears in grey, accented by a microfilament strip cutting through the construction. Orange emerges on the heel, both underneath the upper and on the heel loop, with rope laces supporting the fit. Underfoot, the translucent midsole reveals a full-length Boost unit for cushioning. The shoe released exclusively in select countries in Europe as well as Russia and Ukraine.

With subtle adidas branding on a distinctive outsole in rubber, the adidas Yeezy 500 Kids ‘Blush’ takes a neutral approach to this heritage lifestyle runner. Offering ventilated mesh paired with suede and leather on the upper, the no-tie laces and piping along the shoe in a reflective finish ensure both easy on-and-off and visibility. The adiPRENE+ midsole is reminiscent of the 1999 Kobe Bryant-adidas collaboration. The outsole in ridged rubber offers grippiness underfoot and is embossed with the adidas logo.

shoeName: adidas Yeezy Boost 350 V2 Core Black Red (Infants)
description: The ‘Red’ edition of the Adidas Yeezy Boost 350 V2 Infant has been re-released for Yeezy Day 2022. It features a sleek black Primeknit upper with no-tie laces and stitching details, as well as a bold red stripe with SPLY-350 branding on the side. The shoe is designed to provide a comfortable, snug fit with a lightweight construction. Underfoot, the full-length Boost midsole is surrounded by a black TPU cage for added stability and support, and the bottom features a sturdy rubber outsole.

shoeName: adidas Yeezy Boost 350 V2 Cinder Reflective
description: The Yeezy Boost 350 V2 'Cinder Reflective' emerges with an almost-monochromatic look. Built with Primeknit, the shoe's Cinder upper is bolstered by a bootie-style collar and a heel pull-loop for easy on and off. The signature monofilament stripe sports reflective detailing, while underfoot, an encased Boost midsole gives way to a gum rubber outsole for traction.

shoeName: adidas Yeezy Boost 350 V2 Dazzling Blue (Kids)
description: Updating the sneaker with bold colors is the adidas Yeezy Boost 350 V2 Kids 'Dazzling Blue.' The black Primeknit upper is secured by rope laces and a sock-like construction designed to flexibly hug the foot. 'SPLY-350' is stenciled on a streak of royal blue enlivened on the sneaker's lateral side. It's built on a full-length Boost midsole wrapped in a smoky TPU cage with cut-outs in the durable rubber outsole.

Adidas has brought back the Yeezy Slide Kids ‘Bone,’ featuring an ivory hue. This slip-on style boasts a pared-down and durable design from the use of injected EVA foam. The outsole is designed with strategic grooves which create a sawtooth traction pattern for excellent grip and impact protection. The sandal boasts a minimalist look with an open-toe construction and a comfortable footbed with a soft top layer.

The adidas Yeezy Boost 350 ' Oxford Tan ' features an upper Primeknit oxford / light stone with tonal oxford laces, suede patches, and a Boost outsole. First worn by Kanye at the MTV VMAs in August 2015, the fourth Yeezy 350 colorway was released on December 29, 2015 at select adidas Originals Retail stores.

By the time the Air Yeezy 2 SP ‘Red October’ finally launched online with no advance notice in February 2014, Kanye West had already severed all ties with Nike. Though chaos surrounded the shoe’s much-delayed release, the Red Octobers stand out from its two companion colorways. There’s the monochromatic scarlet finish, contrasted only by metallic gold lace tips, and there’s the unique design, which sees the side panels ditch the standard anaconda texture in favor of rows upon rows of small triangular studs.

shoeName: adidas Yeezy Boost 750 OG Light Brown
description: Kanye West's very first adidas shoe, the Yeezy Boost 750 ' OG ' released in highly restricted amounts globally in February 2015. The towering boot-like construction shows a radical departure from the earlier models of West, featuring a light brown all-suede cap mounted on top of a partly ribbed, boost-equipped rubber midsole in a subtle off-white color.

Sporting a stealthy design, the adidas Yeezy Slide Infants 'Dark Onyx' have a molded upper built with lightweight foam. The open-toe design includes an adjustable heel strap for a secure fit. The three-stripe logo is debossed on the footbed, while deep horizontal grooves on the outsole provide reliable traction and an eye-catching look.

The Yeezy Boost 380 'Hylte Glow' brings a vibrant colorway to its signature build. Built with Primeknit, the shoe's upper sports a camo-style pattern throughout its yellow base, with bright green on the translucent monofilament window. The upper is also treated to a glow-in-the-dark finish, while underfoot, a contrasting grey rubber cage overlays the Boost midsole, which provides cushioning.

Echoing the KB8 3 tooling, Kobe's third shoe in collaboration with adidias, the adidas Yeezy 500 Infants ‘Blush’ offers an easy on-and-off shoe in a neutal color scheme. The upper is contructed from breathable mesh with overlays of suede and leather in ivory with no-tie laces. Built on the same adiPRENE+ midsole as the KB8 3, the rubber outsole with a subtle embossed 'adidas' adds to the chunky look of this heritage shoe.

The Yeezy Boost 350 V2 Infant 'Yecheil' brings a vibrant look to its signature construction. An infants' shoe, the Primeknit upper sports a patchwork-style mix of hues throughout its build, with a black monofilament stripe cutting through the side wall. The rope laces include reflective threads woven into the design, while underfoot, a full-length Boost midsole provides cushioning, overlaid by a black rubber cage.

shoeName: adidas Yeezy Foam RNR Stone Salt (Infants)
description: The adidas Yeezy Foam Runner Infants 'Stone Salt' is crafted from a single piece of injected light tan foam. The molded, flexible and lightweight upper has flowing lines and a series of strategically-placed vents for an airy feel. The three-bar logo at the base of a contoured outsole is the lone logo on this design.

shoeName: adidas Yeezy Boost 350 V2 Cloud White (Infants)
description: The Yeezy Boost 350 V2 Infant combines Kanye West's innovative vision with adidas' classic style. This Cloud White version for kids was launched in September 2019 and features a non-reflective Primeknit material and a unique two-tone stitch pattern. The laces are integrated into the tongue and the outer side is adorned by a trademark clear stripe. Underfoot, the midsole is made with Boost technology that provides an energy-returning experience.
Yeezy Boost 700 MNVN Kids GY4805

shoeName: adidas Yeezy Boost 350 V2 Cloud White (Kids)
description: The adidas Yeezy Boost 350 V2 Kids “Cloud White” in youth sizing takes the popular Yeezy Boost 350 V2 to new heights with this versatile white-based colorway. Covering the supportive yet breathable Primeknit upper is a buoyant Cloud White pattern that features a predominantly white base with hues of light blue woven into the material. A signature Yeezy Boost 350 V2 translucent side stripe spans the mid-panel of the shoe in a creamy white colorway with tonal laces adding a subtle contrasting touch. A white ribbed midsole with Boost foam cushioning encased in the mold adds to the airy vibes of this ultra comfortable lifestyle sneaker. The adidas Yeezy Boost 350 V2 “Cloud White” for kids was released in September 2019.

The adidas Yeezy Foam Runner Infants ‘Sand’ features a minimalist black and white color scheme and a cutting-edge design made of injected EVA foam. The shoe’s upper features several air vents on the front and side to improve ventilation. The bottom of the shoe has a curvy grip design and a subtle adidas logo near the heel. Inside the collar, the shoe size is displayed along with ‘FOAM RNNR’ and ‘Made in USA.’

The Yeezy Boost 350 V2 GID Infant 'Glow' brings its glow-in-the-dark look to infant sizes. The shoe's green Primeknit upper is supported by tonal rope laces and a heel pull-loop, with a translucent monofilament stripe adding the only contrast. Underfoot, a Tubular sole unit includes an encased Boost midsole for cushioning.

shoeName: adidas Yeezy 350 V2 CMPCT Slate Bone (Infants)
description: The classic 350 is delivered in a muted greyscape for tiny feet in the adidas Yeezy Boost 350 V2 CMPCT Infants ‘Slate Bone.’ The upper and collar in Primefit deliver a snug, comfortable fit and no-tie laces ensure easy on-and-off. Constructed on a Boost midsole, which is seen through gaps in the outsole in rubber, the shoe's branding is shared on the sockliner.

The Yeezy Boost 350 V2 'Antlia Reflective' was part of a regional-exclusive released that included non-reflective models. Dropping in Europe in June 2019, the shoe features a two-tone look woven into its Primeknit upper construction, with reflective detailing emerging throughout. Underfoot, a full-length Boost unit provides cushioning in the midsole, with a TPU shell wrap that continues down onto the rubber outsole.

The adidas Yeezy Boost 350 V2 Infants 'Granite Black' has decorative laces on the stretchy Primeknit upper. A 'SPLY-350' signoff is stamped across the black stripe that runs the length of the upper. Custom Yeezy-branded insoles and white three-stripes printed on the heel give these shoes their signature look. A full-length Boost midsole is contained within a sturdy cage and anchored by a ribbed rubber outsole.

shoeName: adidas Yeezy Boost 700 MNVN Bright Cyan (Infants)
description: An infants' iteration of the shoe, the Yeezy Boost 700 MNVM Infant 'Bright Cyan' emerges with a vibrant look. Built with polyester, the shoe's upper appears in Bright Cyan, with reflective silver '700' branding accenting the lateral side. Black no-sew overlays provide support and contrast, with no-tie bungee laces included for easy on and off. Underfoot, full-length drop-in Boost provides cushioning in the polyurethane midsole, giving way to a herringbone rubber outsole for traction.

shoeName: adidas Yeezy Powerphase Calabasas Core White
description: The Yeezy PowerPhase Calabasas ‘OG’ delivers a retro-inspired silhouette from Kanye West’s prolific partnership with adidas. Mined from the brand’s ‘80s archive, the lifestyle trainer features a premium off-white leather upper with perforated three-stirpes, gold foil Calabasas branding and an adidas wordmark on the eyestay logo window.

description:
Kanye West has released a bunch of boots through his Yeezy line over the years. The Yeezy Desert Boot Season 7 Oil is one of the many boot options he unveiled during his run with adidas.

This Yeezy Desert Boot was said to be inspired by both the Yeezy 500 sneaker and the military boots so often worn by soldiers throughout the world. It featured a mesh upper with brown suede and nubuck overlays to give it a rugged look and feel. It also included features like a large reflective tongue pull and thick laces to make it more durable. It was finished off with a chunky black rubber outsole that had big grooves in it to provide proper traction.

This boot was a departure from some of the other footwear included in Yeezy’s Season 7 collection, but that was a big part of what our experts appreciated about it. It didn’t immediately look like a Yeezy shoe, but after inspecting its details more closely, it was clear that it belonged in the Yeezy lineup.
